blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In historical timber buildings, multiple environmental factors act over centuries on wood whose chemical composition varies across anatomical regions, producing complex patterns of degradation. Understanding how timber members degrade is important for the effective conservation and restoration of historical buildings, yet the mechanisms underlying these patterns remain unclear. To investigate these mechanisms, we used self-supervised learning to establish a common basis for comparing specimens from timber members that differ in wood species and service history. We examined transverse sections of 49 wood specimens from several historical buildings in Japan using near-infrared hyperspectral imaging. ChemoMAE, a self-supervised Transformer, learns pixelwise spectral representations through masked denoising that exploits multicollinearity among spectral variables. Clustering these representations yields spatial maps without predefined chemical-state categories. Because anatomy and degradation can produce spatially continuous regions, we formulated Local Label Agreement (LLA) to quantify agreement among labels assigned to neighboring pixels. Using spectra alone, ChemoMAE yielded higher mean LLA than baseline methods on validation specimens. We then trained ChemoMAE anew and fitted cluster centers across all specimens. Spatial structures consistent with wood anatomy and the expected effects of surface exposure emerged in the resulting maps. By cross-referencing regional spectra and spatial distributions across specimens in light of wood anatomy, service histories, and prior studies, we proposed models of internal and surface degradation as mechanistic hypotheses. This exploratory AI for Science framework gives researchers a basis for linking latent patterns learned through self-supervision with domain knowledge when investigating how material states form.
blocks.zh: 在历史木材建筑中,多个环境因素对不同解剖区域化学成分相去甚远的木材有数百年的作用,产生复杂的降解模式. 了解木材成员如何退化对于有效养护和恢复历史建筑十分重要,但这些模式背后的机制仍然不清楚。 为了调查这些机制,我们利用自我监督的学习,为比较木材成员在木材种类和服务史上不同的标本建立了共同的基础。 我们用近红外超光谱成像 检查了日本几个历史建筑的49个木材标本的横截面 ChemomoMAE是一个自我监督的变形器,通过利用光谱变量间多连系性的蒙面去诺来学习像素光谱表达. 将这些表示方式分组产生空间图,而不预先确定化学状态类别。 由于解剖学和降解可以产生空间连续的区域,我们制定了"本地标签协议"(LLA),以量化分配给相邻像素的标签之间的协议. 光利用光谱,ChemoMAE在验证标本上得出的平均LLA值高于基准方法. 然后我们重新训练了ChemoMAE 并且在所有标本上安装了集群中心。 由此产生的地图中出现了与木材解剖学相一致的空间结构以及地表暴露的预期影响。 通过参照木材解剖学、服务历史和先前的研究,相互参照区域谱系和标本之间的空间分布,我们提出了内部和地表退化模型,作为机械假设。 这种探索性科学的AI框架为研究人员提供了一个基础,在调查材料状态如何形成时,将通过自我监督学到的潜在模式与域知识联系起来。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Understanding how timber members degrade during service is important for the conservation and restoration of historical buildings.
Wood species with different anatomical features and chemical compositions have long been used in these buildings.
Even within a single member, centuries of environmental exposure can add to chemical differences already present among anatomical regions.
During service, exposed surfaces undergo weathering through the action of sunlight and rainwater.
Sunlight preferentially degrades lignin, and rainwater can wash away soluble degradation products [ 17 , pp. 274–275] .
Decay and insect damage may also occur depending on the service environment, and a member’s history of wetting and drying is often only partly known [ 37 , pp. 67–68] .
Even in interior wood beyond the direct effects of weathering, chemical changes can occur with age [ 33 ] .
Degradation can be localized within a cross-section, and mechanical properties can vary with distance from the exposed surface [ 41 , pp. 105–106] .
Understanding how the service environment influences the type, severity, and depth of degradation could help estimate how far damage extends into a member and inform assessments of its effective load-bearing cross-section.
Such estimates matter when deciding whether a member can remain in service or requires restoration.
Point measurements can reveal local chemical differences between outer and inner wood, but leave the extent and continuity of altered regions unresolved.
Tracing these regions across a transverse section in relation to the exposed surface and wood anatomy offers clues to the processes that shaped their distribution.
blocks.zh:
了解木材成员如何在服务期间退化,对历史建筑的养护和恢复十分重要。
这些建筑长期使用具有不同解剖特征和化学成分的木种.
即使在一个成员内部,几百年的环境接触也会增加解剖区已经存在的化学差异。
在服务期间,暴露的表面通过阳光和雨水的作用进行风化.
日光优先降解胶原,雨水可以冲走可溶性降解产物[17,第274-275页].
腐烂和昆虫损害也可能根据服务环境发生,一个成员湿润和干燥的历史往往只有部分人知道[37,第67-68页].
即使在超过风化直接影响的内燃木材中,化学变化也会随着年龄变化而发生[33].
降解可以在截面内局部化,机械性质随与暴露表面的距离而变化[41,第105-106页].
了解服务环境如何影响退化的类型、严重性和深度,可有助于估计损害延伸到一个成员的程度,并通报对其有效负载截面的评估。
在决定一个成员是否可以继续任职或需要恢复时,这种估计很重要。
点测量可以揭示出外木和内木的局部化学差异,但使被改变的区域的范围和连续性得不到解决.
在接触的地表和木质解剖中,通过一个横截面来追踪这些区域,为决定其分布的过程提供了线索。

blocks.en:
To examine these distributions, we use near-infrared hyperspectral imaging (NIR-HSI) to record a spectrum at each pixel on a transverse section of each specimen.
We relate the resulting spectral variation to wood anatomy and, where an edge of the section can be linked to a surface exposed during service, examine how far the corresponding regions extend inward from that edge.
Extending the comparison to timber members that differ in wood species and service history allows us to ask which spatial patterns they share and how those patterns vary in extent.
Principal component analysis (PCA), a standard method in chemometrics, summarizes spectral variation by linear projection [ 50 ] , which limits its ability to describe complex nonlinear relationships.
For these comparisons, we learn a common nonlinear representation of pixel spectra through self-supervised masked spectral reconstruction , without assigning chemical-state labels in advance.
We perform unsupervised segmentation by clustering the learned spectral representations using centers shared across specimens.
Plotting each pixel’s cluster label at its original location produces a spatial map showing where each cluster occurs on the transverse section. Wang et al. [49] describe how AI can help scientists uncover structure in unlabeled data and formulate hypotheses for experimental testing.
We cross-reference the spatial distribution of each cluster with its mean NIR spectrum across specimens.
We interpret shared patterns and differences in their spatial extent in light of wood anatomy and the service histories of the timber members to formulate hypotheses about the mechanisms of internal and surface degradation.
blocks.zh:
为了检查这些分布,我们使用近红外超光谱成像(NIR-HSI)在每一个标本的横截面上记录每个像素的光谱.
我们把由此产生的光谱变异与木材解剖学联系起来,如果在服务期间可以将部分的边缘与表面接触联系起来,则审查相应区域从该边缘向内延伸多大。
将比较范围扩大到木材种类和服务历史不同的木材成员,使我们能够了解它们共享的空间格局,以及这些格局在程度上有何不同。
主要成分分析(PCA),是化疗的标准方法,通过线性投影总结光谱变异[50],这限制了它描述复杂的非线性关系的能力.
对于这些比较,我们通过自我监督的蒙面光谱重建来学习像素光谱的常用非线性表示,而无需事先指定化学状态标签.
我们利用在标本上共享的中心,将所学到的光谱表达方式分组,从而进行不受监督的分解。
将每个像素的集群标签绘制在原位置,生成一个空间图,显示每个集群在横切部分发生的地方. 王等编. [49] 描述AI如何能够帮助科学家在无标签的数据中发现结构,并为实验测试制定假设.
我们把每一组的空间分布与各样本的平均国家清单报告频谱相互参照。
我们根据木材解剖学和木材成员的服务历史来解释其空间范围的共同模式和差异,以形成关于内部和表面退化机制的假设。

blocks.en:
We apply this exploratory framework to 49 historical wood specimens representing seven wood taxa from several historical buildings in Japan.
To learn a common spectral representation for these specimens, we introduce ChemoMAE, a self-supervised method that uses a Transformer to learn relationships among wavelength bands in individual pixel spectra.
In NIR spectra, information associated with the same chemical bond appears in multiple bands, contributing to multicollinearity among spectral variables.
ChemoMAE exploits these dependencies through masked reconstruction and combines this task with denoising to reduce sensitivity to measurement-related variations in spectral shape.
In masked denoising , we apply perturbations inspired by signal noise and wavelength shifts to the full spectrum before masking, then reconstruct the pre-perturbation values of the masked bands from the remaining bands.
A low-dimensional bottleneck concentrates the features used for comparison across specimens.
We design the spectral augmentations to preserve the zero mean and constant norm imposed by the standard normal variate (SNV) transformation.
We also normalize the latent representations onto the unit sphere so that cosine similarity provides a common measure in the input and latent spaces.
blocks.zh:
我们把这个探索性框架应用于49个历史木质标本,代表日本若干历史建筑的7个木质分类。
为了学习这些标本的共同光谱表示,我们引入了ChemoMAE,这是一种自我监督的方法,使用变形器来学习单个像素光谱中波长波段之间的关系.
在国家清单报告中,与同一化学结合有关的信息出现在多个频段中,促进了光谱变量之间的多连系性。
ChemoMAE通过蒙面重建利用这些依赖性,并将这项任务与点名相结合,以减少对光谱形状中与测量有关的变异的敏感性.
在蒙面解密中,我们将信号噪声和波长变化所激发的扰动在蒙面解密之前应用到全谱,然后从其余波段重建蒙面解密带的扰动前值.
低维的瓶颈集中了用于对标本进行比较的特征.
我们设计光谱增强值是为了保留标准正常变异(SNV)变换所施加的零平均值和恒定规范.
我们还使单位范围内的潜在表述正常化,以便同位素相似性在输入和潜在空间中提供一个共同的尺度。

blocks.en:
When no ground-truth segmentation can be specified in advance, what evidence would support using these spatial maps for chemical interpretation? Based on prior knowledge of wood anatomy and degradation, we expect regions of similar chemical state to span neighboring pixels at the scale of observation.
If the learned spectral features capture chemical differences among these regions, the resulting segmentation should reflect this spatial structure even when neither representation learning nor clustering uses spatial information.
If these features are learned across specimens, we also expect spatially coherent segmentations in unseen specimens.
We formulated Local Label Agreement (LLA) to measure agreement among neighboring cluster labels and evaluated this expectation using specimen-level cross-validation.
Across all clustering granularities examined, ChemoMAE with masked denoising yielded higher mean LLA on held-out specimens than direct use of the input spectra, PCA, a conventional autoencoder, a denoising autoencoder, or a masked autoencoder trained without additional perturbations.
When prior knowledge suggests that a material’s chemical states have such spatial structure, observing spatial coherence in held-out specimens provides one basis for using the maps for chemical interpretation.
The chemical meaning of individual regions can then be examined in light of their spectra and knowledge of the material.
blocks.zh:
当无法事先说明地面-真实分解时,哪些证据可以支持使用这些空间地图进行化学解释? 根据以前对木材解剖学和降解的认识,我们期望具有类似化学状态的地区在观测尺度上横跨邻近的像素.
如果所学到的光谱特征能够捕捉这些区域之间的化学差异,那么即使代表性学习和集群使用空间信息,由此产生的分化也应反映这种空间结构。
如果在标本上学习这些特征,我们也期望在不为人知的标本中进行空间连贯的分化.
我们制定了地方标签协议(LLA),以衡量邻近集群标签之间的协议,并利用标本级交叉验证来评估这一期望。
在所检查的所有颗粒群中,Chemo 带蒙面解码器的MAE在挂载标本上产生的平均LLA值高于直接使用输入光谱的PCA、常规自动编码器、自动编码器或未经额外干扰而训练的蒙面自动编码器。
当先前的知识表明某一材料的化学状态具有这种空间结构时,在搁置标本中观测空间一致性为使用地图进行化学解释提供了一个基础。
然后可以根据其光谱和对材料的了解来检查各个区域的化学意义.

blocks.en:
Following this evaluation, we learned the spectral representation and fitted the cluster centers anew using spectra drawn from all 49 specimens.
This full-dataset fitting placed the specimens on a common basis for comparison.
Spatial structure consistent with wood anatomy and with the degradation patterns expected from the members’ service environments emerged in the resulting maps.
Interpreting these distributions and the corresponding spectral features in light of the members’ service histories led us to propose models of internal and surface degradation.
In the internal degradation model, aging alters the hydrogen-bonding environment around cellulose microfibrils.
Where water enters the wood, leaching can alter the composition of the remaining cell wall, and repeated wetting and drying may promote local rearrangement of cellulose chains and microfibrils.
In the surface degradation model, sunlight alters lignin in the outermost layer, and rainwater leaches soluble products.
Water carries some acidic degradation products into the wood, where those retained in cell walls may promote secondary reactions upon rewetting.
Anisotropic water transport may contribute to variation in the depth of the resulting transition region.
In this exploratory AI for Science framework, the common representation enables researchers to draw on evidence across diverse specimens when formulating hypotheses about how material states arise.
blocks.zh:
经过这次评估,我们学到了光谱显示,并利用从所有49个标本中提取的光谱重新安装了集群中心。
这套完整的数据集将标本放在共同的基础上进行比较。
由此产生的地图中出现了符合木材解剖学和成员服务环境预期的退化模式的空间结构。
根据各成员的服务历史来解释这些分布和相应的光谱特征,我们提出了内部和表面退化的模式。
在内部降解模型中,衰老会改变纤维素微纤维周围的氢栓环境.
在水进入木质时,浸泡可以改变剩余细胞壁的成分,反复的湿润和干燥可能会促进纤维素链和微纤维的局部重排.
在表面降解模型中,日光改变最外层的利宁,雨水漏液会溶解产物.
水将一些酸性降解产物带入木质中,在木质中保留在细胞壁中的,在再湿化后可能会促进二次反应.
非同位素水运可能助长由此产生的过渡区域深度的变化。
在这个探索性的AI科学框架中,共同的表述使研究人员能够利用各种标本的证据,对材料状态的产生提出假设。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Studies of historical wood have generally reported a decline in hemicellulose content with age, although findings on cellulose crystallinity vary [ 33 ] .
In a poplar member from a historic Chinese temple, Guo et al. examined the wood from the surface inward using imaging FT-IR spectroscopy and complementary measurements.
They found lower cellulose crystallinity and higher equilibrium moisture content in the historical wood than in the reference poplar [ 23 ] .
In wood preserved under dry conditions in a Japanese temple, NIR spectroscopy with deuterium exchange suggested a loss of less ordered cellulose relative to modern wood of the same species [ 45 ] .
Controlled irradiation experiments have also characterized chemical changes near exposed surfaces.
Ultraviolet irradiation degraded aromatic structures in lignin and produced oxidation products that could be extracted with water [ 44 ] .
In Japanese cedar earlywood exposed to simulated sunlight for 1,500 h, FT-IR depth profiles showed increased carbonyl absorption as far as 600–700 μ \mu m below the exposed surface [ 31 ] .
blocks.zh:
对历史木材的研究表明,随着年龄的增长,肝素含量普遍下降,尽管关于纤维素结晶性的调查结果各不相同[33].
在一位来自中国历史神庙的民粹成员郭等. 利用FT-IR成像光谱学和补充测量法,从表面向内检查木材。
他们发现在历史木材中纤维素结晶度较低,平衡水分含量也高于参考poplar [23].
在日本寺庙中干燥条件下保存的木材中,国家营养调查用阴茎交换的光谱表明,相对于同一物种的现代木材而言,纤维素的订购较少。
受控制的辐照实验也呈现了接触表面附近的化学变化特征.
紫外线辐照降解了lig宁的芳香结构,并产生了可以用水提取的氧化产物[44].
在日本雪松早期木在1500小时的模拟阳光照射下,FT-IR深度剖面显示碳酰吸收增加,在暴露的表面以下可达600–700μ\mu[31]米.

blocks.en:
Hyperspectral imaging has also been used to relate spectral variation in wood to known exposure conditions.
Agresti et al. applied PCA to hyperspectral images of artificially irradiated poplar surfaces and found that their shortwave infrared spectra varied with irradiation time [ 1 ] .
Reconstruction-based methods offer another way to extract features from unlabeled spectra.
Denoising autoencoders learn by reconstructing observations from corrupted inputs, while masked autoencoders (MAEs) learn by predicting withheld portions of the input [ 46 , 24 ] .
In Raman spectroscopy, Jensen et al. trained a variational autoencoder to reconstruct spectra from perturbed inputs, and Ren et al. used masked spectral reconstruction in SMAE to learn features for clustering and classifying bacterial spectra [ 27 , 39 ] .
Learned spectral representations have also supported spatial interpretation and comparison across datasets.
GyPSUM clustered representations of NIR pixel spectra and used cluster mean spectra and expert knowledge to interpret mineral distributions [ 19 ] .
RamanMAE mapped subcellular compartments by clustering spectral representations learned through masked reconstruction [ 38 ] .
LeafVAE applied a trained encoder and fixed cluster centers to independent corn leaf datasets, allowing spectral signatures to be compared across measurement conditions [ 28 ] .
blocks.zh:
超光谱成像还被用来将木材的光谱变化与已知的接触条件联系起来。
Agresti等人将五氯苯甲醚应用于人工辐照的波普表面的超光谱图像,并发现其短波红外光谱随辐照时间变化[1].
基于重建的方法为从无标签光谱中提取特征提供了另一种方式.
Denoising 自动编码器通过重建来自腐败输入的观察来学习,而蒙面的自动编码器则通过预测输入的预留部分[46,24]来学习.
在拉曼光谱学中,Jensen et al. 培训了一个可变自编码器,以重建来自扰动输入的光谱。 在SMAE中使用蒙面光谱重建来学习细菌光谱集聚和分类的特征[27,39].
所学得的光谱表示也支持了各数据集的空间解释和比较。
GyPSUM 组合表示国家清单报告像素谱,并使用集群指谱和专家知识来解释矿物分布[19].
RamanMAE通过集群通过蒙面重建学到的光谱表示法绘制了子细胞区间[38].
LeafVAE将经过培训的编码器和固定集群中心应用于独立的玉米叶数据集,从而可以在各种测量条件中比较光谱特征[28].

blocks.en:
Bench et al. asked whether tissue regions containing the same constituents could be distinguished by the spatial arrangement of their spectra.
They constructed synthetic Raman images from measured spectra of porcine muscle and fat, with fat arranged in stripes in some regions and in scattered globules in others.
A convolutional autoencoder trained on image patches learned features that distinguished these arrangements [ 7 ] .
Our study starts from a hypothesis about chemical heterogeneity in historical wood.
Based on prior knowledge of wood anatomy and degradation, we expect regions of similar chemical state to span neighboring pixels on the measured transverse sections.
If a spectral representation captures differences between such regions across specimens, clustering should yield spatially coherent segmentations on unseen specimens even when pixel positions and neighborhood relations are excluded from both representation learning and clustering.
Bench et al. used spatial information to learn representations that distinguish tissue regions.
We use spatial information to evaluate representations learned from spectra alone.
In this hypothesis-driven evaluation, we use LLA to assess whether segmentations of held-out specimens exhibit the predicted spatial coherence.
blocks.zh:
Bench等人询问,是否可通过光谱的空间安排来区分含有相同成分的组织区域。
他们制造合成器 拉曼图像来自测得的猪肉肌和脂肪的光谱,在一些地区以条纹排列脂肪,在另一些地区则以分散的光泽排列脂肪.
一个经过图像补丁培训的进化自动编码器,能够区分这些安排[7].
我们的研究是从关于历史木材中化学异质性的假设开始的。
根据以前对木材解剖学和降解的认识,我们期望化学状态类似的区域在测量到的横截面上横跨相邻的像素.
如果光谱表示法能够捕捉到这些区域在标本上的差异,那么,即使像素位置和邻里关系被排除在表示法学习和集群学之外,聚类也应在空间上形成一致的分块。
Bench等人利用空间信息来学习区分组织区域的表达方式。
我们利用空间信息来评价光谱就学到的表示.
在这个假说驱动的评价中,我们使用LLA来评估被搁置的标本的片段是否表现出了预测的空间一致性.

blocks.en:
Studies of wood aging, water exposure, and weathering have characterized changes in cell-wall chemistry and structure under a range of conditions [ 5 , 45 , 29 ] .
Work in hyperspectral imaging has also shown how learned spectral representations can support expert interpretation of spatial maps and comparison across specimens [ 19 , 28 ] .
We bring these lines of work together around a question for hyperspectral studies of materials.
When ground-truth labels for material states are scarce, how can researchers use a learned representation to connect observations across diverse specimens with findings from prior studies and formulate hypotheses about how those states arose?
We examine this question in historical timber members that differ in wood species and service history.
To assess the basis for using the maps for chemical interpretation, we compare ChemoMAE with PCA and alternative autoencoders on held-out specimens, using the spatial coherence expected from wood anatomy and degradation as our criterion.
We then learn a shared spectral representation and fit a common set of cluster centers using spectra from all specimens.
An interpretation suggested by a cluster’s mean NIR spectrum and its location in one specimen can thus be examined against the mean spectrum, location, and extent of the same cluster in other specimens.
We use the shared patterns and differences across specimens to ask how processes documented under different conditions might be linked in historical wood.
These comparisons lead us to propose models of internal and surface degradation.
blocks.zh:
对木材老化、水暴露和风化的研究在一系列条件下对细胞壁化学和结构的变化作了定性[5、45、29]。
超光谱成像方面的工作也表明,所学光谱表示法如何支持专家对空间地图的解释和对标本的比较[19,28].
我们把这些工作线 围绕一个问题 超光谱研究材料。
当材料状态的地面真伪标签很少时,研究人员如何利用学到的表述方法,将不同标本的观测结果与以前研究的结果联系起来,并对这些状态的产生提出假设?
我们在木材种类和服务历史不同的历史木材成员中研究这个问题。
为了评估使用这些地图进行化学解释的依据,我们以木材解剖和降解所期望的空间一致性作为我们的标准,将ChemoMAE与停产标本上的五氯苯甲醚和替代自动编码器进行比较。
然后我们利用所有标本的光谱来学习一个共同的光谱表示,并适合一组共同的集群中心。
因此,可以对照同一组别在其他样本中的平均值、位置和范围来审查一个组别的平均国家清单报告谱及其在一个样本中的位置。
我们利用不同标本的共同模式和差异来问,在不同条件下记录的进程如何在历史木材中联系起来。
这些比较使我们提出了内部和表面退化的模式。

blocks.en: 3 Materials and Data Preparation
blocks.zh: 3 材料和数据编制

blocks.en:
Figure 1: Pseudo-RGB images of the measured surfaces of seven specimens, one per taxon.
From left to right: Chamaecyparis obtusa , Pinus sp., Zelkova serrata , Tsuga sieboldii , Castanea crenata , Cryptomeria japonica , and Abies sp.
Specimen IDs are shown below each image.
blocks.zh:
图1 Pseudo-RGB 七种标本的测量表面图像,每类1种.
从左到右:Chamaecyparis obtusa、Pinus sp.、Zelkova serrata、Tsuga sieboldii、Castanea crenata、Cryptomeria japonica和Abies sp.
每个图像下方显示样本ID.

blocks.en: 3.1 Historical Wood Specimens
blocks.zh: 3.1 历史木材样本

blocks.en:
We studied 49 historical wood specimens taken from timber members in several historical buildings.
The specimens represented seven wood taxa, five identified to species and two to genus: 14 Chamaecyparis obtusa , 23 Pinus sp., four Zelkova serrata ,
one Tsuga sieboldii , three Castanea crenata , three Cryptomeria japonica , and one Abies sp.
Each specimen was identified by an ID beginning with KYOw;
the associated site, building, timber member type, and wood taxon are listed in Appendix A.1 .
The combination of these attributes differed for most specimens.
Neither taxonomic identity nor member type served as a supervisory label for chemical state.
blocks.zh:
我们研究了从几个历史建筑中的木材成员中提取的49个历史木材标本.
标本代表了7种木质分类,5种被确定为物种,2种被确定为物种: 14 Chamaecyparis obtusa, 23 Pinus sp., 四塞尔科娃塞拉塔,
其中一个是Tsuga Sieboldii,三个是Castanea crenata,三个是Cryptomeria japonica,另一个是Abies sp.
每个标本由KYOW的ID识别;
附录A.1列出了相关的场地、建筑物、木材成员类型和木材分类。
这些属性的组合对于大多数标本来说是不同的.
分类特征和成员类型都不是化学状态的监督标签。

blocks.en:
For specimens with matching attributes, visual inspection of the original timber members revealed differences in surface characteristics and degradation state,
from which we inferred differences in the service environments of the sampled locations.
Even within a single member, exposure may have varied with location, for example between the outdoor-facing and indoor-facing sides of a column.
However, no records establish whether these specimens came from the same member
or how they were positioned relative to each other during service.
blocks.zh:
对于具有匹配属性的标本,对原始木材成员的目视检查显示出表面特征和降解状态的差异,
我们从中推断了抽样地点服务环境的差异。
即使在单个成员内部,接触可能因地点而异,例如,柱体的室外表面和室内表面。
但是,没有记录确定这些标本是否来自同一成员
或在服役期间他们是如何相对地定位的。

blocks.en:
The specimens were approximately 10 mm thick. We imaged a transverse section of each specimen.
Where an edge of the section could be linked to a side face exposed during service, we used that edge as a reference for assessing how far a region extended inward within the section.
The specimens were stored at approximately 25 ∘ C and 60% relative humidity and measured in an air-dry state.
The degree of sanding and surface finishing was not standardized across specimens;
the measured surfaces included untreated surfaces and surfaces with traces of insect damage.
blocks.zh:
标本厚度约10毫米. 我们描绘了每个标本的横截面
如果部分的边缘与服务期间暴露的侧面相连接,我们则使用这一边缘作为参考,评估一个区域在部分内部的延伸程度。
这些标本存放于 25°C和60%的相对湿度,在空气干燥状态下测量.
不同标本的沙化和表面完成程度没有标准化;
测量的表面包括未经处理的表面和有昆虫损害痕迹的表面。

blocks.en:
Before examining the analytical results, we selected one illustrative specimen per taxon (Figure 1 ).
The pseudo-RGB images provide an overview of the shape and anatomical structure of the measured surfaces.
Pseudo-RGB images of all 49 specimens are shown in Appendix A (Figure A.1 ).
blocks.zh:
在审查分析结果之前,我们选择了每个分类的1个说明性标本(图1)。
伪RGB图像提供了所测量表面的形状和解剖结构的概况.
所有49个标本的Pseudo-RGB图像在附录A(图A.1.

blocks.en: 3.2 NIR-HSI Measurement
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家清单报告HSI 计量

blocks.en:
Near-infrared hyperspectral images were acquired using a line-scan Compovision system
(CV-N800-HS, Sumitomo Electric Industries) equipped with an InGaAs sensor.
Two halogen lamps, one on each side, provided illumination.
The measured surfaces of the specimens were visually adjusted to a common height,
and the specimens were scanned on a translation stage at a constant speed.
blocks.zh:
利用线扫描复合系统获得了近红外超光谱图像
(CV-N800-HS,Sumitomo Electric Industries)装备了InGaAs传感器.
两盏卤灯,每边各一盏,提供照明.
标本的测量表面被视同高度调整
并且标本被扫描 在翻译阶段 恒定的速度。

blocks.en:
Measurement conditions were the same for all 49 specimens:
a frame rate of 200 Hz, an exposure time of 4.5 ms, and a stage scanning speed of 37.53 mm/s.
Each line comprised 320 spatial pixels and 256 wavelength bands.
The acquired wavelength range was 913.10–2518.47 nm,
with intervals of 6.25–6.34 nm between adjacent bands.
The spatial sampling interval, calculated from the approximately 60 mm field of view and the scanning speed,
was approximately 0.19 mm in both directions.
blocks.zh:
所有49个标本的测量条件相同:
a帧速率200赫兹,曝光时间4.5ms,级扫描速度37.53mm/s.
每条线由320个空间像素和256个波长波段组成.
获得的波长范围为913.10-2518.47 没有,
相邻带间间隔为6.25-6.34nm.
从约60毫米视场和扫描速度计算出来的空间取样间隔,
两个方向大约为0.19毫米。

blocks.en:
Before measurement, a single line was acquired for each of the white and dark references
using the same frame rate and exposure time as for the specimens.
A barium sulfate (BaSO 4 ) white plate was used for the white reference and a lens cap for the dark reference;
neither reference acquisition involved scanning.
blocks.zh:
在测量前,为每个白暗参考获得一条单行
使用与标本相同的帧率和曝光时间。
用于白色参考物的硫酸 bar(BASO 4)白色板块和用于暗色参考物的镜头盖;
获取参考书目均不涉及扫描。

blocks.en: 3.3 Data Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 3.3 数据处理

blocks.en:
During preprocessing, specimen masks were used to extract wood regions from the near-infrared hyperspectral images.
Reflectance conversion, wavelength-range selection, resampling
and the standard normal variate (SNV) transformation [ 6 ] were then applied sequentially to each pixel spectrum.
These fixed preprocessing steps were common to all specimens and all comparison conditions.
Excluded pixels were displayed as background.
blocks.zh:
在预处理过程中,使用标本口罩从近红外超光谱图像中提取木质区域.
反射转换、波长范围选择、复制
和标准的普通变位(SNV)变位[6]然后相继应用于每个像素谱.
这些固定的预处理步骤是所有标本和所有比较条件共同的.
排除的像素被显示为背景 。

and c ∈ { 1 , … , C } c\in\{1,\ldots,C\} indexes the bands.

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Specimen Mask
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 取样面具

blocks.en:
For each specimen, multi-Otsu thresholding was applied to the ℓ 1 \ell_{1} norms of the pixel intensity spectra 𝐢 u , v \mathbf{i}_{u,v} to partition the pixels into three classes.
The class with the lowest values was treated as background, and the other two classes as candidate wood regions.
To reduce the influence of pixels containing mixtures of wood and background,
the candidate regions were eroded inward by one pixel to obtain the specimen mask.

为了减少含有木材和背景混合物的像素的影响,

We used the ratio of the mean reference difference to its standard deviation across columns

blocks.zh: 3.3.3 标准正常变异变异

We used the SNV transformation as a common preprocessing step to compare relative spectral shapes [ 6 ] .
This transformation can be applied independently to each pixel without a reference spectrum or tuning parameters,
and removes differences in offsets and positive scaling that are common to all bands.

这种转换可以独立应用到每个像素上,没有参考谱或调制参数,
并消除所有波段常见的抵消和正缩放差异。

blocks.en: 4 Representation Learning and Unsupervised Segmentation
blocks.zh: 4 代表学习和非监督分部

blocks.en: 4.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 4.1 概览

blocks.en:
ChemoMAE takes as input the spectrum 𝐱 u , v \mathbf{x}_{u,v} after SNV transformation
at each pixel ( u , v ) (u,v) in the set of valid pixels Ω \Omega defined in Section 3.3 .
Hereafter, we omit the pixel indices and write 𝐱 \mathbf{x} unless otherwise specified.
blocks.zh:
ChemoMAE 在 SNV 转换后将频谱 x u, v\ mathbf{x}_{u,v} 输入
在3.3节定义的有效像素组合值\Omega中,每个像素(u, v) (u, v) 。
后世,我们省略像素索引并写入 x\ mathbf{x} 除非另有说明 。

blocks.en:
Figure 2: ChemoMAE architecture and analysis workflow.
(a) Projection and normalization of the CLS-token output.
(b) Training by masked denoising.
(c) Unsupervised segmentation based on the learned representations.
blocks.zh:
图2:ChemoMAE架构和分析工作流程。
(a) CLS-token产出的预测和正常化。
(b) 蒙面打假培训。
(c) 根据学到的表述,不受监督地分割。

blocks.en:
For methods that learn agreement between augmented views,
augmentation design must reflect the information to be preserved [ 11 ] .
When spectral differences related to material state arise from unknown or combined factors,
the desired invariances are difficult to specify in advance.
We therefore adopted reconstruction-based learning, using the observed spectra as reconstruction targets.
The model learns interband dependencies through input reconstruction rather than directly enforcing agreement between latent representations.
Building on denoising autoencoders [ 46 ] and MAEs [ 24 ] ,
we use masked denoising [ 51 ] as the pretext task.
blocks.zh:
对于在扩大的意见之间取得一致的方法,
扩增设计必须反映需要保存的信息[11].
当与物质状态有关的光谱差异由未知或综合因素产生时,
很难事先说明所希望的变动。
因此,我们采用了基于重建的学习方法,将观察到的光谱作为重建目标。
该模型通过投入重建而不是直接执行潜在表述之间的协议来学习带间依赖。
利用自动编码器[46]和MAEs[24],
我们用蒙面的诽谤作为借口

blocks.en:
We refer to the input transformations produced by Tangent Gaussian Noise (TGN) and Fractional Shift (FS) as additional perturbations.
In the standard configuration, we apply any selected perturbations to the full spectrum before masking wavelength patches.
The model then predicts the pre-perturbation values of the masked bands from the remaining bands.
The perturbations are intended to reduce sensitivity to spectral fluctuations that could obscure chemical differences between regions.
We clustered the learned representations and mapped the labels back to pixel coordinates to construct spatial maps.
We examine how the spatial coherence of segmentations on held-out specimens changes when training shifts from full-spectrum reconstruction to prediction of masked bands.
We also assess how additional spectral perturbations affect spatial coherence under each reconstruction task (Section 5.1 ).
blocks.zh:
我们把Tangent Gaussian Noise(TGN)和FS(FS)产生的输入转换称为额外的扰动.
在标准配置中,在遮掩波长补丁之前,我们将任何选定的扰动应用到全谱.
该模型随后预测了来自其余乐队的蒙面带的扰动前值.
扰动的目的是降低对光谱波动的敏感性,这种波动可能掩盖各区域之间的化学差异。
我们把学习到的表达方式组合起来,并将标签映射回像素坐标,以构建空间地图。
我们审查在培训从全谱重建转向对蒙面带的预测时,被搁置标本上的片段的空间一致性是如何变化的。
我们还评估额外的光谱扰动如何影响每项重建任务下的空间一致性(第5.1节)。

blocks.en: 4.2 ChemoMAE
blocks.zh: 4.2 化学制品

blocks.en:
Like dimensionality reduction by PCA [ 50 ] ,
ChemoMAE constructs low-dimensional representations for exploring and comparing spectral differences.
The bottleneck maps the final output of the encoder’s classification (CLS) token to d d dimensions with an affine layer
and normalizes it to give one unit-length representation per spectrum.
blocks.zh:
如五氯苯甲醚的维度减少[50],
ChemoMAE构建低维表示法,用于探索和比较光谱差异.
瓶颈将编码器分类符号( CLS) 的最终输出映射到带有affine 层的 d 维度
并且使其正常化,使每个频谱有一个单位长度的表示。

blocks.en:
The channels of the input spectrum 𝐱 \mathbf{x} are divided into N N patches, 𝒫 1 , … , 𝒫 N \mathcal{P}_{1},\ldots,\mathcal{P}_{N} ,
each containing the same number of contiguous channels along the wavelength axis.
Let ℳ ⊂ { 1 , … , N } \mathcal{M}\subset\{1,\ldots,N\} denote the set of masked patch indices
and 𝒱 = { 1 , … , N } ∖ ℳ \mathcal{V}=\{1,\ldots,N\}\setminus\mathcal{M} the set of unmasked patch indices.
A specified number of masked patches are sampled uniformly at random without replacement from all N N patches,
independently for each input spectrum and anew at every training step.
blocks.zh:
输入频谱的频道 x\ mathbf{x} 分为 N N 补丁, P 1, ..., P N\ mathcal{ P}_{1},\ ldots,\ mathcal{ P}_{N},
每一个都包含相同数量沿波长轴的毗连通道。

blocks.en: 4.3 SNV-Based Spectral Augmentation
blocks.zh: 4.3 基于SNV的光谱增强

blocks.en:
The additional perturbations were designed to vary the normalized spectral shape
without reintroducing the mean and scale variations removed by SNV transformation.
blocks.zh:
额外的扰动设计是为了改变正常光谱形状
而不重新引入SNV变换所消除的平均值和比例变化.

blocks.en:
The usefulness of data augmentation for learning is not determined solely
by how closely generated examples resemble actual observations.
Improvements in classification performance have been reported with Mixup [ 54 ] and CutMix [ 53 ] , which artificially combine inputs and their supervisory signals.
Vicinal Risk Minimization (VRM) [ 9 ] assigns vicinity distributions to training examples
and minimizes the expected loss under their mixture.
From this perspective, we regard placing vicinity distributions within the set of vectors
with zero mean and a constant norm as a design choice for the inductive bias of this study.
blocks.zh:
数据扩充对学习的用处不只确定
以所生成的事例与实际观察相似的程度。
分类性能的改进报告有Mixup[54]和CutMix[53],它们人工结合了投入及其监督信号.
邻里风险最小化(VRM)[9] 将附近分布分配给培训实例
并尽量减少其混合物的预期损失。
从这个角度出发,我们考虑把附近分布放在 一套矢量中
以零平均值和恒定规范作为本研究诱导偏差的设计选择.

blocks.en:
Fearn et al. [16] explain mean removal and length normalization by SNV transformation
in terms of placing spectra on a spherical surface.
Building on this geometric account, we explicitly define the set containing the inputs
and construct TGN and FS using the tangent space and renormalization.
blocks.zh:
Fearn et al. [16] 解释通过 SNV 转换去除和长度正常化的含义
在球面上放置光谱。
根据这个几何分类,我们明确界定了包含输入的一组
并使用切换空间和重新正常化来构建 TGN 和 FS。

blocks.en:
Both transformations are applied to all C C components before masking and generate training examples within the same set.
They are inspired by signal noise [ 21 ] and wavelength shifts [ 8 ] ,
but do not guarantee reproduction of measurement errors or preservation of chemical states.
blocks.zh:
这两种变换都应用到所有C C组件中,然后掩盖并在同一组中生成培训实例.
它们受到信号噪声[21]和波长变化[8]的启发,
但不保证重复测量错误或保持化学状态。

Because FS is applied before masking, values near the boundaries of the target bands
may be included in unmasked bands through shifting and interpolation.
The reconstruction target remains fixed at the pre-perturbation values at the same wavelength positions.

因为FS在遮掩之前被应用,所以值接近目标带的边界
可以通过移位和插值将波段纳入无假带。
重建目标仍固定在相同波长位置的扰动前值.

blocks.en: 4.4 Unsupervised Segmentation
blocks.zh: 4.4 无监督的分割

blocks.en:
Latent representations for visualization and clustering were obtained with the trained model fixed,
without spectral augmentation and with all patches unmasked.
We quantized these representations into K K clusters and compared their spatial distributions.
Cluster labels do not imply an ordering of degradation severity or correspond to predefined chemical states.
blocks.zh:
用经过培训的模型固定了视觉化和集群化的典型表述,
没有光谱增强 和所有补丁解面。
我们将这些表述量化为KK集群,并比较它们的空间分布.
集群标签并不意味着对降解严重程度的排序,也不对应预先定义的化学状态。

blocks.en:
For the main analysis, we used Cosine-KMeans, an implementation of spherical k k -means
that partitions directions on the unit sphere using cosine similarity [ 4 ] .
In conventional k k -means, even when the inputs are ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized,
cluster centers computed as the arithmetic means of their assigned data points generally do not have unit norm.
Cosine-KMeans ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalizes the cluster centers after every update
and assigns inputs according to their cosine similarities to the centers.
blocks.zh:
在主要分析中,我们使用了Cosine-KMEANs,这是球状kK-意指的应用.
,使用余弦相似性在单位球体上分割方向 [4] 。
在常规 k k - 意思中, 即使输入值是 l 2\ell\% 2} - 正常化,
作为指定数据点的算术手段计算出来的集群中心一般没有单位规范。
在每次更新后, Cosine-KMEANs l 2\ell\2} - 将集群中心正常化
并根据其余弦的相似性向中心分配输入。

blocks.en:
The resulting cluster labels were mapped back to the original coordinates of each pixel.
Valid pixels were assigned labels 1 , … , K 1,\ldots,K , and background and excluded pixels were assigned 0.
Neither representation learning nor clustering used spatial coordinates or neighborhood relations,
and no spatial regularization or post-assignment label smoothing was applied.
This unsupervised segmentation procedure is illustrated in Figure 2 (c).
blocks.zh:
由此产生的集群标签被映射回每个像素的原始坐标.
有效的像素被分配到标签 1, ..., K 1,\ ldots, K, 背景和排除的像素被分配到 0 。
既未进行代表性学习,也未将所使用的空间坐标或邻里关系组合起来,
并且没有实行空间规范或任务后标签平滑。
图2(c)说明了这种不受监督的分割程序。

blocks.en: 5 Experimental Design and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5 实验设计和评价

blocks.en:
We used specimen-level cross-validation (CV) to evaluate the spatial coherence of segmentations of unseen specimens,
followed by full-dataset fitting for cross-specimen comparison and NIR-based chemical interpretation.
blocks.zh:
我们利用标本水平的交叉验证(CV)来评价未见标本的分区的空间一致性,
之后是适合跨谱比较和国家清单报告化学解释的完整数据集。

blocks.en: 5.1 Comparison Conditions and Ablation Design
blocks.zh: 5.1 比较条件和设计

blocks.en: 5.1.1 Main Comparison Conditions
blocks.zh: 5.1.1 主要比较 条件

blocks.en:
Table 1 summarizes six main conditions and two ablations of the additional perturbations;
M11 was the standard ChemoMAE configuration.
To compare representations under common preprocessing, we used SNV-transformed reflectance spectra from individual pixels (Section 3.3 ) in every condition, including PCA (B1).
We used second derivatives of pseudo-absorbance only for chemical interpretation after segmentation (Section 5.4 ).
B0 used the 256-dimensional input directly, whereas the other conditions reduced it to 16 dimensions.
blocks.zh:
表1总结了六个主要条件和两个附加扰动;
M11是标准的ChemoMAE配置.
为了比较常见预处理下的表示,我们在每个条件中,包括五氯苯甲醚(B1)都使用了单像素的SNV变形反射光谱(第3.3节).
我们只用假吸收的第二衍生物进行分解后的化学解释(第5.4节)。
B0直接使用256维的输入,而其他条件将其降低到16维.

blocks.en:
The input spectra in B0 and the PCA scores in B1 were ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized before clustering.
No additional wavelength-wise standardization or whitening was applied in the PCA of B1.
All neural network conditions (A0, A1, and M00–M11) shared the encoder, bottleneck, and affine decoder
described in Section 4.2 , including ℓ 2 \ell_{2} normalization of the latent representations during training.
All reconstruction targets were the inputs before additional perturbations,
and the loss was the mean squared error over the bands specified in Table 1 .
The training procedure and loss for the M conditions followed Section 4.2 and Eq. ( 6 ).
blocks.zh:
B0中的输入光谱和B1中的PCA分数是l 2\ell\%2} - 分组前的正常化.
B1的五氯苯甲醚没有采用额外的波长标准化或白化法。
所有神经网络条件(A0,A1,和M00–M11)共享编码器,瓶颈,和affine解码器
第4.2节所述,包括在培训期间使潜在的陈述正常化。
所有重建目标都是在增加干扰之前的投入,
而损失是表1所列波段的平均平方差错。
M类条件的培训程序和损失遵循第4.2节和Eq.(6)节。

blocks.en:
Each enabled perturbation was applied to each pixel with probability 0.5,
and their order when combined was randomized for each batch.
The strength distribution of each perturbation was shared across conditions;
the operations and the rationale for their strengths are described in
Section 4.3 and Appendix B.1 .
The training pixels, number of epochs, and optimization settings were also shared,
and we used the final weights after 800 epochs (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh:
每个启用的扰动被应用到每个像素中,概率为0.5,
以及每批组合时的顺序。
每次扰动的强度分布在各种条件下均匀;
有关业务及其长处的理由说明载于
第4.3节和附录B.1。
还分享了培训像素、时代数和优化设置,
我们使用了800个纪元后的最后权重(附录C).

blocks.en:
We compared masked denoising (M11) with direct use of the input spectra (B0), PCA (B1), the conventional and denoising autoencoders (A0 and A1), and masked reconstruction without additional perturbations (M00).
To examine the contribution of the reconstruction task, we compared A0 with M00 without additional perturbations
and A1 with M11 with additional perturbations.
Both comparisons changed input masking and the bands included in the loss,
contrasting reconstruction of all bands with prediction of masked bands.
blocks.zh:
我们用直接使用输入光谱(B0)、五氯苯甲醚(B1)、常规和去诺化自动编码器(A0和A1)和蒙面重建而不增加扰动(M00)来比较蒙面代号(M11)。
为了审查重建任务的贡献,我们把A0和M00进行比较,而没有引起更多的干扰。
A1与M11加加扰动.
两次比较都改变了输入遮盖和损失中的波段,
对比所有乐队的重建与蒙面乐队的预测.

blocks.en:
To examine additional perturbations, we compared A0 with A1 without masking
and used a 2 × 2 2\times 2 TGN–FS design within the M conditions, with a common mask ratio and the loss computed only over masked bands,
to assess the individual contributions of the two perturbations, their combined contribution and their interaction.
Interaction estimates and aggregation are described in Section 5.2.3 .
We did not compare these perturbations with alternatives that fail to preserve the mean and norm.
blocks.zh:
为了检查更多的扰动,我们把A0比作A1,没有蒙面
并使用2×2 2\times 2 TGN – FS 设计在 M 条件下,带有共同的遮罩比率,损失只计算在遮罩带上,
评估两个扰动的个人贡献、它们的综合贡献及其相互作用。
第5.2.3节介绍了相互作用估计和汇总。
我们没有将这些扰动与未能维持这种卑鄙和规范的替代办法相比较。

blocks.en: 5.1.2 Clustering of the Representations
blocks.zh: 5.1.2 (中文(简体) ). 代表的分组

blocks.en:
Representation extraction and unsupervised segmentation followed Section 4.4 ,
with Cosine-KMeans used in all conditions (Appendix C.4 ).
blocks.zh:
第4.4条:
在所有条件下均使用Cosine-KMEANs(附录C.4)。

blocks.en:
We treated the number of clusters K K as the granularity at which the spectral distribution was examined.
Before inspecting the evaluation results, we fixed the common set 𝒦 = { 2 , 4 , 6 , 8 , 10 , 12 , 14 } \mathcal{K}=\{2,4,6,8,10,12,14\} for all conditions, folds, and repetitions.
Considering the combined effects of surface degradation, internal aging, anatomical differences, and moisture histories,
we specified K 0 = 8 K_{0}=8 in advance as the granularity for the main tables and full-dataset maps.
We did not prescribe the states or factors corresponding to individual clusters.
For each condition, fold, and repetition, we varied K K while keeping the representations fixed
to examine how differences between conditions depended on this granularity.
blocks.zh:
我们把K K 星团的数目作为审查光谱分布的颗粒性。
在检查评价结果前,我们固定了常见的套装K={2,4,6,8,10,12,14}\mathcal{K}=\{2,4,6,8,10,12,14}所有条件,折叠,重复.
考虑到表面退化、内部衰老、解剖差异和水分历史的综合影响,
我们预先指定了 K 0 = 8 K_{0}=8 作为主表格和完整数据集图的颗粒性。
我们没有规定与单个集群对应的状态或因素。
对于每一个条件,折叠和重复,我们改变KK,同时保持表示固定
以审查各种条件之间的差异如何取决于这种颗粒性。

blocks.en: 5.2 Cross-Validation and Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 5.2 交叉更改和评价计量

blocks.en: 5.2.1 Cross-Validation Design
blocks.zh: 5.2.1 交叉变异设计

blocks.en:
All conditions used the same five folds, formed by randomly partitioning the 49 specimen IDs (KYOw) without stratification by exposure history or wood taxon.
We ran cross-validation three times using the same five folds, holding out each specimen once per run.
blocks.zh:
所有条件都使用相同的五个折叠,通过随机分化49个标本ID(KYOw)而形成,没有通过曝光历史或木质分类分类法分层.
我们用同样的五个折叠进行三次交叉验证,每次验证一次每个标本。

blocks.en:
To balance the contributions of specimens with different numbers of pixels,
we sampled 8192 8192 pixels uniformly at random without replacement from each training specimen in each fold.
This sample size was fixed in advance based on computational cost and the number of available pixels.
Within each fold, the same sampled pixels were used to fit PCA, train the neural networks,
and fit Cosine-KMeans across all conditions, values of K K , and repetitions.
blocks.zh:
为了平衡不同像素的标本的贡献,
我们随机抽取了8192 8192像素 但没有替换每个折叠的训练标本
这种样本大小是根据计算成本和可用像素数量预先确定的.
每个折叠中,相同的样本像素被用来装配PCA,训练神经网络,
并适合所有条件、KK值和重复的Cosine-KMEANs。

blocks.en:
For each held-out specimen, we kept the fold-specific representation transformation and cluster centers fixed.
We transformed all valid pixel spectra and assigned the resulting representations to clusters as described in Section 4.4 .
We refer to this procedure as out-of-fold (OOF) evaluation.
blocks.zh:
对于每个被搁置的标本,我们保持了折叠特定代表转换和集群中心的固定.
我们改变了所有有效的像素光谱,并如第4.4节所述,将由此产生的表述分配给集群。
我们将此程序称为 " 外部评估 " 。

blocks.en:
Only the random seeds for neural network training and clustering varied across runs.
In each repetition, we trained the neural networks from scratch and fitted Cosine-KMeans to their representations.
For B0 and B1, the input representations or the PCA transformation fitted within each fold were held fixed,
and only clustering was repeated.
blocks.zh:
只有用于神经网络培训和集群的随机种子横跨各地。
在每次重复中,我们从零开始训练神经网络,并将科辛-KMEANs装配到他们的表达.
对于B0和B1,每个折叠体内安装的输入表示或电容变换被固定,
只重复了分组。

blocks.en: 5.2.2 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 5.2.2 评价计量

blocks.en:
Local Label Agreement (LLA) was the primary metric for assessing consistency with the expectation
of spatial coherence on unseen specimens.
Under the hypothesis described in Section 1 , representations that capture chemical state differences across specimens
are expected to yield high LLA on unseen specimens.
However, high LLA alone does not establish that these differences have been correctly captured.
Pixel neighborhood relations were used to calculate LLA but were excluded from representation learning and cluster assignment.
Label Flip Rate (LFR) was an auxiliary metric for examining whether more stable assignments
under the specified perturbations were accompanied by higher LLA.
blocks.zh:
地方标签协议是评估是否符合预期的主要指标
在未见标本上的空间一致性。
根据第1节所述假设,捕捉不同标本的化学状态差异的表述
预计将在隐形标本上产生高法学硕士学位。
然而,仅靠高法学硕士并不能确定这些差异是否得到正确反映。
像素邻里关系被用于计算LLA,但被排除在代表学习和集群任务之外.
标签翻转率(LFR)是审查是否更稳定任务的一个辅助指标
在规定的骚扰下,还附有较高的法学硕士学位。

Unless otherwise stated, the condition, K K , and repetition are fixed in the following definitions.

and n s , k n_{s,k} the number of pixels assigned to cluster k k .
Background pixels and pixels excluded by the quality criteria were omitted
from both the evaluation and spatial neighborhoods.

blocks.en:
We report LLA-3, LLA-5, and LLA-9 separately, and use LLA-5 when presenting comparisons for a single neighborhood width.
Cases in which Eq. ( 11 ) is undefined, including assignment to a single cluster ( P s = 1 P_{s}=1 ), are excluded from aggregation.

我们分别报告LLA-3、LLA-5和LLA-9,并在比较一个街区宽度时使用LLA-5。
未定义Eq. (11)的情况,包括对单一集群的转让(Ps = 1 P_{s}=1),被排除在汇总之外。

blocks.en:
LLA equals one minus the variance-weighted mean of Geary’s C C [ 20 ] for the binary indicator variables of the clusters represented within a specimen.
The correspondence between the uncorrected agreement rate and join-count statistics,
the properties of the chance correction, and the derivation of this equivalence
are given in Appendix D .
blocks.zh:
LLA等于1减去Geary的C C[20]的差值加权平均值,用于标本中代表的集群的二进制指标变量.
未更正的协议率与合并统计之间的对应关系,
机会校正的属性,以及这种等值的衍生
见附录D。

blocks.en:
LFR is the fraction of pixels whose labels change when spectral perturbations are applied with the model held fixed.
For each perturbation type, all valid pixels of each specimen were evaluated five times using different perturbation realizations,
and the arithmetic mean was taken as the specimen’s LFR.
A lower LFR indicates more stable labels under the specified perturbations.
blocks.zh:
LFR是像素的一小部分,其标签在光谱扰动被固定的模型应用时会发生变化.
对于每种扰动类型,每个标本的所有有效像素都通过不同的扰动实现进行了五次评价,
并且算术平均值被作为标本的LFR.
低LFR表示在规定的扰动下标签较为稳定.

blocks.en:
The combined use of TGN and FS was the main evaluation perturbation;
TGN alone and FS alone were also evaluated separately.
The operations, strength distributions, and ordering when combined matched those used during training
(Sections 4.3 and 5.1 ),
with only the application probability of the enabled operations changed to one.
Perturbations were applied to the input spectra before the representation transformation.
The same perturbation realization for each pixel was shared across all conditions, values of K K , and repetitions.
The representation transformation and cluster centers were held fixed,
and inference with the AE, denoising AE, and ChemoMAE used all patches without masking.
blocks.zh:
综合使用TGN和FS是主要的评价干扰;
此外,还单独评估了TGN和FS。
行动、兵力分配和订购与训练中使用的相同
(第4.3和5.1节),
,只有启用操作的应用概率改为一个。
在表示转变前,对输入光谱进行了干扰。
每个像素的同样扰动实现在所有条件、KK的值和重复中都得到共享。
代表制转变和集群中心得到固定,
和推论AE, 发音AE, 和ChemoMAE使用所有补丁 不蒙面。

blocks.en:
To calculate silhouettes [ 40 ] ,
we normalized each condition’s representations to unit length and used cosine distance,
defined as one minus cosine similarity; we refer to this metric as cosine-silhouette.
We pooled all valid pixels from the held-out specimens in each fold to calculate a silhouette value for each pixel,
then took the arithmetic mean over all valid pixels within each specimen to obtain its score.
Although specimens receive equal weight in the final aggregation,
average distances to each cluster are calculated from all pooled pixels within a fold,
so specimens with more pixels contribute more to these distance averages.
Because distance structures differ between conditions,
we treated cosine-silhouette as an auxiliary diagnostic describing separation within each representation space.
Our clustering quantizes spectral representations at granularity K K ;
it does not require clearly separated groups or maximization of the silhouette.
blocks.zh:
计算形状 [40],
我们把每个条件的表达方式 改为单位长度 并使用余弦距离,
定义为一个负余弦相似度;我们将此度量称为余弦-西弦。
我们从每个折叠的被搁置的标本中集合了所有有效的像素,以计算每个像素的硅光值,
然后对每个标本内的所有有效像素采用算术平均值以获得其分数.
虽然标本在最终聚合中获得同等份量,
从折叠内的所有集合像素计算出每个集群的平均距离,
因此,具有更多像素的标本对这些距离平均值的贡献更大.
因为不同条件的距离结构不同
我们把宇宙光线作为辅助诊断 描述每个代表空间内的分离
我们的组合将光谱表示值量化为颗粒K;
它并不要求明确分开的组合或最大程度的斜线。

For specimen s s , cluster occupancy is π s , k = n s , k / N s \pi_{s,k}=n_{s,k}/N_{s} ,
and maximum occupancy is max k ⁡ π s , k \max_{k}\pi_{s,k} .
The number of clusters used, K s used K_{s}^{\mathrm{used}} ,
is the number of clusters to which at least one pixel in the specimen is assigned.
These diagnostics were used to detect concentrated assignments or assignment to a single cluster.

blocks.en: 5.2.3 Aggregation and Paired Comparisons
blocks.zh: 5.2.3 合计和比较

blocks.en:
For each metric, condition, K K , and repetition, we averaged specimen scores with equal weights,
then averaged the three repetition means to obtain the summary value.
Variability among specimens is reported as the sample standard deviation of the specimen scores averaged over repetitions.
CV summaries used the OOF scores from all five folds.
blocks.zh:
对于每个度量,条件,KK,和重复, 我们平均标本得分 与等重,
然后平均三次重复获得汇总值。
报告标本的可变性是标本的样本标准差,平均比重复得分.
CV摘要使用了所有五个折叠的OOF分数.

blocks.en:
Differences between conditions were calculated as paired differences for the same specimen, K K , and repetition.
For each specimen, the paired difference was averaged over the three repetitions.
We summarize these paired differences across specimens by reporting their mean, their sample standard deviation
and the number of specimens with a difference in the direction of improvement.
blocks.zh:
不同条件之间的差别被计算为同一标本KK的配对差异和重复。
每个标本的配对差异平均为三次重复.
我们通过报告样本的平均值 样本标准偏差来总结这些对子差异
和在改进方向上有区别的标本数量.

blocks.en:
Undefined values were not imputed.
A condition’s summary value used only specimens with defined values in all three repetitions for that condition.
Differences between conditions used the common set of specimens with defined values in all three repetitions of both conditions,
with the number of specimens and the reasons for undefined values reported alongside the results.
The treatment of undefined values and degenerate segmentations is described in Appendix C.6 .
blocks.zh:
未定义的值未被估算 。
一个条件的总结值只使用在所有三次重复中都有定值的标本。
各种条件之间的差异均使用共同的一组标本,在三种条件的所有重复中都有确定值,
标本的数量以及随结果一起报告的未定义值的原因。
附录C.6说明了对未定义值和退化分解的处理。

blocks.en:
For each specimen, K K , and training repetition, the TGN–FS interaction was calculated as ( M11 − M01 ) − ( M10 − M00 ) (\mathrm{M11}-\mathrm{M01})-(\mathrm{M10}-\mathrm{M00}) using the corresponding metric values,
separately for each LLA neighborhood width and LFR perturbation type.
Only specimens with defined values in all four conditions and all three repetitions were included.
These contrasts were aggregated as described above for paired differences.
A positive LLA contrast or a negative LFR contrast indicates an interaction in the direction of improvement
relative to the sum of the individual effects.
blocks.zh:
对于每个标本 K K, 和训练重复, TGN – FS 交互被计算为 (M11 – M01) – (M10 – M00) (\ mathrm{ M11} -\ mathrm{ M01}) –\\ mathrm{ M10} -\ mathrm{ M00}) , 使用相应的度量值,
每个LLA区宽度和LFR扰动类型分别列出.
只有在所有四个条件中都有定义值的标本和所有三个重复都包括在内.

blocks.en: 5.3 Full-Dataset Fitting and Spatial Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 完整数据集的配置和空间分析

blocks.en:
For each condition, we used spectra drawn from all 49 specimens to obtain a common basis for comparing maps across specimens.
We compared spatial maps across the six main conditions (B0, B1, A0, A1, M00, and M11) at K 0 = 8 K_{0}=8 and used the M11 assignments for the clusterwise NIR analysis in Section 5.4 .
blocks.zh:
对于每个条件,我们使用从所有49个标本中抽取的光谱来获得一个共同的基础来比较各标本的地图.
我们比较了K 0 = 8 K_{0}=8的六个主要条件(B0、B1、A0、A1、M00和M11)的空间地图,并在第5.4节中利用M11任务进行分组国家清单报告分析。

blocks.en:
We sampled 8192 8192 valid pixels uniformly at random without replacement from each specimen
and shared the sampled pixels across all conditions.
Using the same settings as in CV, we fitted PCA once and trained each neural network once from scratch.
With the representation transformation and fitting pixels held fixed,
we fitted Cosine-KMeans three times, changing only its initialization seed; the seeds were shared across conditions.
In each repetition, the representation transformation and cluster centers were applied to all valid pixels, including the fitting pixels.
The first repetition, selected in advance, was used for the maps.

我们随机抽取了8192 8192个有效像素,没有替换每个标本
并分享所有条件的样本像素。
使用与CV相同的设置,我们安装了PCA一次,并且从头培训了每个神经网络一次.
随着代表的转变和装配像素的固定,
我们装了3次Cosine-KMEANs, 只改变它的初始化种子; 种子是有条件的。
在每次重复时,表示转换和集群中心都适用于所有有效的像素,包括配位像素.
第一次重复是事先选定的,用于地图。

blocks.en:
We calculated LLA-3, LLA-5, and LLA-9 from all valid pixels to describe and compare
the spatial coherence of segmentations in the specimens included in fitting
(see Section 5.2.2 for definitions).
Aggregation and paired comparisons followed Section 5.2.3 ,
including the treatment of undefined values and common specimen sets.

(定义见第5.2.2节)。
第5.2.3节,

blocks.en:
To examine whether spatial structure consistent with prior knowledge emerged in maps derived from spectra alone,
we examined cluster distributions in relation to growth rings on the measured transverse sections and, where the position of a surface exposed during service could be inferred, in relation to that surface.
We compared regions across maps in terms of their extent, boundaries, relative positions and patterns of splitting or merging.
We also examined correspondence with the scanning direction for possible variation associated with the measurement system.
Comparative maps are presented in Appendix E.2 .
blocks.zh:
为审查仅从光谱中得出的地图中是否出现了符合先前知识的空间结构,
我们研究了与测量到的横截面的生长环有关的组群分布,以及在可推断服务期间暴露的表面位置的地方,研究了与该表面有关的组群分布。
我们从地图的范围、界限、相对位置和分割或合并模式的角度比较了各区域。
我们还审查了与扫描方向的对应关系,以确定与测量系统有关的可能变化。

blocks.en:
Based on prior knowledge of wood anatomy and degradation, we expected regions of similar chemical state to span neighboring pixels at the scale of observation.
For specimen-level spectral comparisons, we visually inspected each map and selected clusters whose assigned pixels formed discernible regions (Appendix G.2 ).
Where the position of a surface exposed during service could be inferred, we also compared regions near that surface with regions in the interior.

对于标本水平的光谱比较,我们可视地检查了每一幅地图和选定的集群,这些集群的指定像素形成明显的区域(附录G.2)。

We use band numbers 1–18 throughout (Tables 5 and F.2 ).
We checked the assignments in Table 2 of Schwanninger et al. [42] against original NIR studies [ 15 , 2 , 36 ] .
For the selected specimens and clusters, second-derivative values for these bands
were obtained by piecewise linear interpolation along the wavenumber axis.
For an assignment at a single wavenumber, we used the interpolated value;
for an interval, we used the minimum value over the interval, including its endpoints.
After visual inspection of the second-derivative spectra,
we plotted 13 bands in the bar charts (Figures 7 and 9 ), excluding bands 8, 11, 12, 13, and 14 because their second-derivative troughs were indistinct.
For comparison, assignments including combination bands were organized into four groups:
polysaccharide-related C–H, lignin-related C–H, polysaccharide-related O–H, and water-related bands.
Assignments spanning more than one group or having multiple candidates were marked with *.
We defined the band value as the sign-reversed second derivative, − d 2 A / d λ 2 -d^{2}A/d\lambda^{2} ,
so that deeper negative troughs gave larger values.
This is a measure of curvature and does not directly represent constituent abundance.
Because the finish of the measured transverse surfaces varied among specimens (Section 3.1 ), we could not separate its possible contribution to differences in second-derivative band values from that of wood chemistry.

The common reference, termed the baseline, was constructed from clusters judged to be relatively sound.
Within each specimen, we averaged band values equally over the selected baseline clusters present, if any.
Baseline and individual-cluster values were then averaged with equal weights across their respective contributing specimens.
Missing values were not imputed in either aggregation.
We examined the direction of paired band-value differences within specimens contributing to both groups.

在每个标本中,我们平均比照现有(如果有的话)选定的基准组群得出波段值。
然后,对基准值和单个组群值进行平均值,对其各自的标本进行加权。

我们研究了两组标本中成对带值差异的方向。

For each band, the bar charts show the mean across specimens for each cluster or the baseline group divided by the corresponding baseline mean.
The baseline is thus one, and the same baseline was used in both the internal and surface degradation plots.
Paired comparisons used specimen-specific relative band values,
obtained by dividing each specimen’s band value by the same baseline mean across specimens.
Second-derivative spectra were used to compare absolute amplitudes between bands.

blocks.en:
Within each specimen, we related the mean NIR spectrum of each selected cluster to the location and extent of the regions assigned to it.
We then cross-referenced these observations across specimens to examine whether an interpretation suggested by one specimen was consistent with the spectrum and spatial distribution of the same cluster in others.
In interpreting shared patterns and differences, we drew on published band assignments, wood anatomy, specimen provenance and taxon, and the available evidence on service conditions at the sampled locations in the original timber members.

然后,我们对这些标本的观测结果进行了交叉参考,以审查一个标本所建议的解释是否与其他标本的频谱和空间分布一致。
在解释共享模式和差异时,我们借鉴了已公布的带状任务、木材解剖学、标本来源和分类以及原始木材成员取样地点服务条件的现有证据。
