blocks.en: 6 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 6. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: 6.1 Spatial Coherence on Unseen Specimens
blocks.zh: 6.1 不明样本的空间一致性

blocks.en:
At the prespecified K = 8 K=8 , the standard masked denoising configuration (M11) gave the highest mean OOF LLA
at all three neighborhood widths (Table ).
For most held-out specimens, M11 also gave higher LLA-5 than direct use of input spectra (B0) or PCA (B1)
(Table 3 ).
B0 and B1 yielded higher LLA than the two unmasked AEs (A0 and A1),
making them strong reference conditions for unseen specimens.
For B0 and B1, representations were held fixed within each fold and only clustering was repeated;
for the neural network conditions, representations were learned anew in each repetition,
so the evaluation also included variation due to representation learning.
blocks.zh:
在预先指定的 K = 8 K = 8 时, 标准蒙面解密配置 (M11) 给出了最高的平均值 OOF LLA
所有三个街区宽度(表)。
对于大多数被搁置的标本,M11还给出了比直接使用输入光谱(B0)或PCA(B1)更高的LA-5.
(表3) (中文(简体) ).
B0和B1产生的法学硕士学位高于两个未装潢的AE(A0和A1),
使它们成为隐形标本的有力参考条件。
就B0和B1而言,每个组合内都有固定的表示,只重复分组;
对于神经网络条件, 在每次重复中,
因此,评估中还包含了由于代表学习而产生的差异。

blocks.en:
The advantage over B0 and B1 was not limited to a particular number of clusters (Figure 3 ).
LLA generally decreased with increasing K K , but the M conditions, including M11,
exceeded B0 and B1 at every K K and neighborhood width examined.
Differences among the M conditions were small:
M10 slightly exceeded M11 at all three neighborhood widths for K = 12 K=12 and in LLA-9 for K = 14 K=14 .
These results show that representations learned by masked reconstruction remained useful
as K K , the granularity of analysis defined in Section 5.1 , was varied.
blocks.zh:
相对于B0和B1的优势并不限于特定数量的集群(图3 ).
法学硕士学位一般随着KK的增长而减少,但M类条件,包括M11,
在检查的每个 K K 和附近宽度时超过 B0 和 B1 。
M类条件之间的差异很小:
M10在K=12 K=12的所有三个街区宽度上略高于M11,在LLA-9中,K=14 K=14.
这些结果表明,蒙面重建的表述仍然有用。
由于第5.1节界定的分析的颗粒性KK不同。

blocks.en:
The higher LLA of the M conditions in segmentation based on spectra alone
is consistent with the expectation in Section 1 that spatial coherence would emerge in unseen specimens if features capturing state differences were learned across specimens.
These results support the learned representations’ usefulness in terms of the expected spatial coherence on unseen specimens.
blocks.zh:
M类条件中仅基于光谱分化的更高LLA
符合第1节的预期,即如果在标本之间了解了记录国家差异的特征,空间一致性将在无形标本中出现。
这些结果支持了所学得的表述在未见标本的预期空间一致性方面的效用。

blocks.en:
The value of evaluating this expected property is also illustrated by the contrast with cosine-silhouette.
The M conditions showed higher mean LLA but lower cosine-silhouette values than B0 and B1
(Table ).
Cosine-silhouette and LLA capture distinct properties: cluster separation within each representation space
and local spatial coherence within each segmentation, respectively.
Choosing a metric of cluster separation in representation space solely because clustering is used would overlook this expected spatial property.
This contrast highlights the value of hypothesis-driven evaluation design:
selecting metrics according to properties expected from scientific hypotheses rather than the analytical method alone.
blocks.zh:
评估这一预期财产的价值也表现在与余弦色素的对比上。
M 条件显示的LLA 平均值高于 B0 和 B1
(表23) (中文(简体) ).
Cosine-Silhouette和LLA 捕捉不同的属性:在每个代表空间内的集群分离
和每个区段内的地方空间一致性。
仅仅因为使用了集群,在代表空间中选择分组隔离的尺度就会忽略这种预期的空间属性。
这种对比突出了假说驱动的评价设计的价值:
根据科学假设而不是仅分析方法所期望的属性选择衡量标准。

blocks.en: 6.2 Effects of Reconstruction Tasks and Spectral Augmentation
blocks.zh: 6.2 重建任务的影响和规模的扩大

blocks.en:
Replacing reconstruction of all bands with prediction of masked bands improved
the spatial coherence of segmentations of unseen specimens.
In OOF evaluation at K = 8 K=8 , mean LLA-5 increased and LFR(TGN+FS) decreased
in both M00 − - A0 and M11 − - A1, which changed input masking and the bands included in the loss
while keeping the model architecture the same (Table 3 ).
Improvements were observed across a wide range of specimens,
and the mean LLA-5 difference was positive in all three repetitions for both comparisons
(Table D.2 ).
blocks.zh:
以预测蒙面带取代所有带的重建
可见标本分块的空间一致性。
在OOF评价中,K=8K=8,平均LLA-5增加,LFR(TGN+FS)减少
M00 - - - A0 和 M11 - - - A1 均改变了输入遮盖和损失中的波段
同时保持模型架构不变(表3).
在广泛的样本中观察到改进,
和平均LLA-5的差别在所有三次重复中都是正数
(表D.2)。

blocks.en:
These improvements suggest that masked reconstruction is well suited to NIR spectra,
which contain related chemical information across multiple bands.
NIR spectra contain overtone and combination bands associated with the same chemical bonds
across multiple wavelength regions, and band overlap and multicollinearity are characteristic features of these spectra.
Thus, information reflecting state differences is not confined to a single band
and can occur redundantly across different bands.
Predicting masked bands from the remaining bands exploits this redundancy
and encourages learning of variation shared across bands and interband dependencies.
Under the constraint of reconstruction by an affine decoder from a single low-dimensional representation
(Section 4.2 ), predictive cues linking multiple bands must be concentrated in that representation.
We suggest that this contributed to learning features shared across specimens
without relying on particular bands alone.
blocks.zh:
这些改进表明,蒙面重建非常适合国家清单报告谱系,
包含多个波段的相关化学信息。
国家清单报告光谱含有与相同化学键有关的透音和组合波段
这些光谱的特点是波段重叠和多连系。
因此,反映国家差异的信息不局限于单一的波段。
并且可以在不同的乐队中重复出现。
利用这种冗余功能
并鼓励学习波段和波段间依赖之间共享的变异。
受来自单一低维代表物的近缘解码器的重建制约
(第4.2节),将多个波段联系起来的预测提示必须集中在这种表述上。
我们建议,这有助于在标本上分享的学习特征。
不依赖特定的乐队。

blocks.en:
More stable assignments under the specified perturbations did not necessarily coincide
with greater spatial coherence of segmentations of unseen specimens.
In A1 − - A0, LFR(TGN+FS), averaged over three repetitions, decreased in all 49 specimens,
whereas mean LLA-5 decreased.
LFR assesses responses to perturbations of the same types and strength distributions as those used during training,
whereas LLA assesses label agreement among actual spatial neighbors,
whose neighborhood relations are excluded from both representation learning and clustering.
blocks.zh:
特定扰动下较稳定的任务不一定一致
在空间上更加一致地划分了未见标本
在A1−-A0中,LFR(TGN+FS)平均重复三次以上,在所有49个标本中减少,
而LLA-5则减少了。
LFR评估与培训中使用的相同类型和强度分布的扰动反应,
而LLA评估实际空间邻居之间的标签协议,
其邻里关系被排除在代表学习和集群之外。

blocks.en:
In M11, which combined additional perturbations with masked reconstruction,
the reduction in LFR(TGN+FS) relative to M00 was accompanied by a small increase in mean LLA-5.
For inputs sampled from the vicinity distributions designed in Section 4.3 ,
the model must predict the pre-perturbation values of masked bands even when the unmasked bands have been perturbed.
This combination may have encouraged the representation to capture interband relationships
that were less sensitive to these transformations, contributing to the additional gain in spatial coherence.
Because M00 also had lower LFR(TGN+FS) than A0 despite having no additional perturbations,
the reconstruction task itself contributed to more stable assignments.
The role of denoising training with additional perturbations should therefore be considered
in combination with the reconstruction task.
blocks.zh:
在M11中,它把额外的扰动和蒙面重建结合起来,
与M00相比,LFR(TGN+FS)的减少伴随着平均LLA-5的少量增加。
对于从第4.3节设计的附近分布区抽取的投入,
模型必须预测蒙面带的扰动前值,即使蒙面带已经扰动.
这种组合可能鼓励代表抓住波段间关系。
这些变化对这些变化不太敏感,有助于空间一致性方面的额外收益。
由于M00的LFR(TGN+FS)也比A0低,尽管没有额外的扰动,
重建任务本身有助于更稳定的任务。
因此,应考虑以额外的干扰来取消培训的作用。
与重建任务相结合。

blocks.en:
Adding TGN or FS individually mainly stabilized assignments under the corresponding specified perturbation,
and changes in mean LLA-5 were small.
The mean interaction effect when the two were combined was in the direction of improvement
for LLA and LFR(TGN+FS), but in the opposite direction for LFR(FS).
Moreover, the sign of the LLA-5 difference changed across repetitions
in all four comparisons of additional perturbations,
so these effects were less consistent than the improvements due to changing the reconstruction task
(Table D.2 ).
blocks.zh:
在相应的指定扰动下,增加个别的TGN或FS主要稳定的任务,
平均LLA-5的变动很小。
两者合并时的平均互动效应是朝改进的方向发展
用于LLA和LFR(TGN+FS),但LFR(FS)方向相反.
此外,LLA-5的差别因重复而改变
在所有四项额外扰动的比较中,
因此,这些效果不如由于改变重建任务而带来的改善一致。
(表D.2)。

blocks.en:
We did not search over the mask ratio or the augmentation strengths of TGN and FS to maximize LLA.
The supplementary comparison of mask ratios is presented in Appendix E.3 as a sensitivity analysis relative to the main condition of 50% and was not used to select the main condition.
blocks.zh:
我们没有搜索TGN和FS的面具比率或增强优势,以尽量扩大LLA。
面具比率的补充比较在附录E.3中作为相对于50%的主要条件的灵敏度分析提出,没有用于选择主要条件.

blocks.en: 6.3 Spatial Patterns after Full-Dataset Fitting
blocks.zh: 6.3 完全数据集连接后的空间模式

blocks.en:
We compared spatial maps obtained by full-dataset fitting under the six main conditions, focusing on M11.
The fitting included spectra from all 49 specimens examined in this analysis.
As an illustrative example, we present KYOw16744, a Cryptomeria japonica specimen
from a bearing block (masu) in the main hall of Komyoji Temple
(Figure ; Table A.1 ).
blocks.zh:
我们比较了在六个主要条件下由全套数据集获得的空间地图,重点是M11。
该装置包括本分析中审查的所有49个标本的光谱。
作为一个例子,我们展示了KYOw16744, 一个密码标本
由Komyoji寺主堂的轴承块(masu)构成
(图;表A.1)

blocks.en:
M00 and M11 clearly delineated regions following the growth rings and continuous regions along the periphery.
Growth-ring structure comprising earlywood and latewood is visible on the measured transverse surface
(Figure 1 ).
Parts of the perimeter of the measured transverse section correspond to surfaces of the original timber member that were exposed during service.
Given the photodegradation of wood surfaces by ultraviolet radiation [ 1 ] ,
the peripheral regions corresponding to exposed surfaces are expected to differ in state from the interior.
Spatial structure consistent with this prior knowledge emerged without using spatial information
in representation learning or clustering and without label smoothing.
This correspondence supports the use of the learned spectral representations to explore state differences.
blocks.zh:
M00和M11沿生长环和沿边缘连续区域明确划定了区域。
由早期木材和晚期木材组成的生长环状结构可见于测量的横向表面
(图1).
测量到的横截面周界部分与原始木材成员在服役期间暴露的表面相对应。
鉴于紫外线辐射使木材表面光降解[1],
与暴露的表面相对应的边缘区域预计与内陆不同。
不使用空间信息而出现与以往知识相一致的空间结构
在代表学习或集群中,不带标签平滑。
这种函式支持使用所学光谱表达法来探索状态差异.

blocks.en:
For B0 and B1, which provided strong reference conditions in OOF evaluation,
correspondence with wood anatomy was less readily discernible.
In B0, regions varying over broader spatial extents were superimposed on those following the growth rings.
In B1, the combination of labels representing the growth-ring structure varied by location.
These assignments may have strongly reflected variations in surface properties and other factors,
in addition to differences in chemical state.
Such variations can also yield high LLA if they produce spatially continuous regions;
the usefulness of the maps for interpreting the distribution of state differences
therefore needs to be considered together with qualitative evaluation based on prior knowledge.
blocks.zh:
B0和B1为OOF评价提供了有力的参考条件,
与木质解剖学的通信比较不易发现。
在B0中,生长圈之后的区域在更广泛的空间范围内存在差异。
在B1中,代表生长环结构的标签组合因位置而异.
这些转让可能强烈反映了表面特性和其他因素的变化,
除了化学状态的不同
这种变化如果产生空间连续区域,也可产生高法学硕士;
地图对解释国家差异分布情况的用处
因此,需要结合基于先前知识的定性评价来考虑。

blocks.en:
A0 exhibited numerous fine-scale variations in assignments along the vertical scanning direction,
superimposed on the growth-ring structure.
The prominence of these variations in A0, which shared the network architecture of M00 and M11,
shows that introducing a neural network alone is insufficient
and that the design of the learning task used to organize representations is important.
blocks.zh:
A0沿垂直扫描方向,在任务上表现出许多细度的变化,
叠加在增长环结构上。
这些变化在A0中的突出地位,它们共享M00和M11的网络架构,
说明仅引入神经网络是不够的
并且设计用于组织表述的学习任务是重要的.

blocks.en:
A1 exhibited fewer fine-scale variations in assignments along the scanning direction than A0.
Although these variations were barely noticeable in M00,
a straight-line pattern crossing the growth-ring structure appeared in the cluster assignments near the right edge of the specimen.
This pattern was not clearly visible at the same location in M11.
Their alignment with the scanning direction suggests an influence of the measurement system.
We hypothesize that denoising training with additional perturbations reduced assignment sensitivity
to the local variations underlying the straight-line pattern while the model learned interband relationships,
contributing to both the weaker pattern in M11 and the small increase in mean OOF LLA relative to M00
(Section 6.2 ).
blocks.zh:
A1在扫描方向上的任务的细度变化小于A0。
虽然这些变化在M00中几乎不明显,
穿过生长圈结构的直线图案出现在靠近标本右边缘的集群任务中。
这一模式在M11的同一地点没有明显可见.
它们与扫描方向一致表明测量系统具有影响。
我们假设这种用额外的扰动调试 降低了任务敏感性
直线图案背后的局部变化,而模型学到了波段间的关系,
造成M11模式较弱,平均OOF LLA相对于M00略有增加
(第6.2节).

blocks.en:
In KYOw16744, regions had similar extents and arrangements in the A1, M00, and M11 maps.
Other specimens showed similar patterns (Appendix E.2 ).
Across all 49 specimens, mean LLA-5 was 0.536 for A1 and 0.526 for M11 (Table 4 ).
A1 had the highest LLA-5 and LLA-9, whereas M11 had the highest LLA-3.
Mean LLA-5 was higher in A1 than in A0 and higher in M11 than in M00.
blocks.zh:
在KYOw16744中,各地区在A1,M00和M11地图中具有相似的范围与安排.
其他标本显示类似图案(附录E.2.
在所有49个标本中,平均LLA-5为A1的0.536,M11为0.526(表4)。
A1拥有最高的LLA-5和LLA-9,而M11拥有最高的LLA-3.
A1的LLA-5平均数高于A0,M11的比率高于M00。

blocks.en:
The difference in spatial coherence between A1 and M11 became clear in OOF evaluation.
Mean LLA-5 for A1 exceeded that for A0 in full-dataset fitting but was lower in OOF evaluation
(Table ).
The full-dataset maps showed how A1 and M11 organized spectral variation within the specimens used to train the encoders and fit the cluster centers.
When we used each fold’s trained encoders and fitted cluster centers to segment its held-out specimens,
mean LLA-5 over the three repetitions was higher under M11 than under A1 for all 49 specimens
(Table 3 ).
This contrast highlights the need to evaluate generalization explicitly, even in unsupervised segmentation.
blocks.zh:
在OOF评价中,A1和M11在空间一致性上的区别变得很明显.
A1的平均LLA-5比全套数据集中的A0多,但OOF评价较低
(表23) (中文(简体) ).
完整的数据集地图显示,A1和M11如何在用于培训编码器和适合集群中心的标本中组织光谱变异。
当我们使用每个折叠的训练有素的编码器 和装配的集群中心 来分割其被搁置的标本时,
在所有49个标本中,M11的LLA-5比A1的LLA-5比A1的多
(表3) (中文(简体) ).
这种对比突出了明确评价一般化的必要性,即使在不受监督的分割中也是如此。

blocks.en:
When we repeated representation learning and clustering for M11 on the same data, characteristic cluster distributions persisted
and many boundaries recurred at similar locations despite changes in individual pixel assignments
(Appendix F.2 ).
Taken together, the spatial coherence of segmentations on unseen specimens (Section 6.1 ),
the agreement of the full-dataset maps with prior knowledge, and the stability of spatial patterns across repetitions
support our use of M11 as the common basis for cross-referencing spectra and spatial distributions across specimens.
In the next section, we draw on these comparisons, published NIR band assignments, and specimen information
to interpret chemical differences among the mapped regions.
blocks.zh:
当我们在同一数据上反复学习和组合M11的表述时,特征集群分布持续存在
尽管单个像素任务有变化,但许多边界在类似地点重现
(附录F.2.
综合了未见标本上的片段的空间一致性(第6.1节),
* 完整数据集图与以往知识的一致,以及重复的空间格局的稳定性
支持我们使用M11作为相互参照标本的光谱和空间分布的共同基础。
在下一节,我们利用这些比较、公布的国家清单报告任务和样本信息。
解释所绘制区域之间的化学差异。

blocks.en: 6.4 Chemical Interpretation and Degradation Models
blocks.zh: 6.4 化学解释和降解模型

blocks.en:
Table 5: NIR band assignments for Figure , based on the review by Schwanninger et al. [42] .
Appendix G.1 gives the detailed assignments and their primary sources.
Daggers (†) mark the 13 bands used in the bar charts (Figures 7 and 9 ). A plus sign denotes a combination of vibrations.
blocks.zh:
表5:根据Schwanninger等人的审评,为图......分配的国家清单报告频段。 [42] (中文(简体) ).
附录G.1列出了详细的任务及其主要来源。
匕首(†)标记条形图中使用的13个带(图7和图9)。 加号表示振动的组合.

blocks.en:
Figure 7: Relative band values for the baseline and interior clusters 5 and 4 at the 13 selected bands (baseline = 1 =1 ).
Band numbers correspond to Table 5 . Asterisks mark assignments that span more than one group or have multiple candidates.
Numbers in parentheses in the legend are specimen counts.
blocks.zh:
图7: 13个选定波段的基准组和内组5和4的相对波段值(基线=1=1)。
带号与表5相对应。 Asterisks标记了跨越一个以上组或有多个候选人的任务。
传说中括号内的数字是标本计数.

blocks.en:
Figure 9: Relative band values for the interior baseline and surface clusters 3 and 8 at the 13 selected bands (baseline = 1 =1 ).
Band numbers correspond to Table 5 . Asterisks mark assignments that span more than one group or have multiple candidates.
Numbers in parentheses in the legend are specimen counts.
blocks.zh:
图9:13个选定波段(基线=1=1)的内置基线和表面集群3和8的相对波段值。
带号与表5相对应。 Asterisks标记了跨越一个以上组或有多个候选人的任务。
传说中括号内的数字是标本计数.

blocks.en:
We used the published band assignments summarized in Table 5 to interpret the aggregated second-derivative spectra of the M11 clusters (Figure ).
We compared these spectral features with the cluster distributions and spectra in individual specimens
(Figure G.1 ), taking into account information on the original timber members.
Similarities and differences within and across specimens informed our interpretation of chemical states in the wood interior and at the surface.
Table summarizes the interpretation of each cluster and the evidence supporting it.
All six specimens selected for the comparison of cluster 2 spectra were Pinus sp., and the spectral features suggest a contribution from pine resin, so we exclude this cluster from the degradation models.
blocks.zh:
我们利用表5中概述的已公布的带状任务来解释M11集群的累计第二演化光谱(图)。
我们把这些光谱特征 和单个标本中的组群分布和光谱进行比较
(图G.1),考虑到原木材成员的资料。
标本内部和之间的相似性和差异为我们对木材内部和表面化学状态的解释提供了依据。
表概述了对每一组的解释及其佐证。
用来比较第2组光谱的所有6个标本都是Pinus sp.,光谱特征表明松树脂有贡献,所以我们将该组从降解模型中排除.

blocks.en:
Band values reflect both the contributions of wood constituents and their molecular environments. They do not directly measure constituent abundance.
We refer to cellulose and hemicellulose collectively as polysaccharides, and to constituents containing aromatic rings, such as lignin and phenolic extractives, as aromatic constituents.
blocks.zh:
带值既反映木材成分的贡献,也反映其分子环境. 它们不直接衡量成分丰度。
我们把纤维素和肝糖素统称为聚沙酰胺,把含有芳香环的成分,如列宁和苯丙烯提取物称为芳香成分。

blocks.en:
In interpreting the cellulose O–H bands, we consider both the contribution of cellulose and the hydrogen-bonding partners of its hydroxyl groups in the cell wall.
Cellulose chains form microfibrils, and multiple microfibrils form bundles within the cell wall.
The hydrogen bonds that the hydroxyl groups form can vary with the local arrangement of the chains,
the relative positions of adjacent microfibrils within a bundle, and their positions relative to surrounding polymers.
We refer to these arrangements collectively as the supramolecular structure of the cell wall .
Because the specimens were measured in the air-dry state, we interpret band 17 as a feature of bound water retained in the cell walls.
blocks.zh:
在解释纤维素O-H带时,我们既考虑纤维素的贡献,也考虑细胞壁中其羟基组的氢捆绑伙伴的贡献.
纤维素链形成微纤维,多个微纤维在细胞壁内形成捆绑.
羟基组形成的氢键会随着链的局部安排而变化,
相邻微纤维在捆绑物内的相对位置及其相对于周围聚合物的位置。
我们把这些安排统称为细胞壁的超分子结构。
由于标本是在空气干燥状态下测得的,所以我们把第17波段解释为细胞壁中保留的捆绑水的一个特征.

blocks.en:
The spatial distribution of chemical states may also reflect the pathways by which water entered the timber during service and transported wood constituents.
The orientation of wood cells makes water penetration direction-dependent.
The longitudinal (L) direction follows the grain, along the long axes of tracheids and vessels.
The radial (R) direction extends outward from the pith, and the tangential (T) direction is tangent to the growth rings.
Free water can flow along cell lumina and through pits between cells. It generally penetrates wood more readily in the L direction than in the R or T direction [ 22 ] .
On the measured transverse surfaces, L is perpendicular to the plane of observation, and R and T lie within it.
blocks.zh:
化学状态的空间分布也可能反映水在服务期间进入木材和运输木材成分的途径。
木质细胞的取向使得水的渗透方向依赖.
纵向(L)方向沿着谷物,沿着气管和船只的长轴.
光圈(R)方向从pith向外延伸,微小(T)方向与生长环正切.
自由水可以沿着细胞lumina流动,也可以通过细胞间的坑. 它一般比R或T方向的木材更容易穿透L方向[22].
在测量到的横截面上,L与观测平面垂直,R和T位于其中.

blocks.en:
Cluster 7 occurred in softwood latewood and in the interior of hardwood specimens. Its spectra showed a pronounced second overtone of cellulose C–H stretching (band 3), first overtones of O–H stretching (7 and 9), and combination bands (4, 16, and 18) associated with cellulose
(Figures , (a), and G.1 ).
These features were weaker in clusters 1 and 6, which occurred in softwood earlywood, in parts of the latewood, and in hardwood interiors.
Based on these distributions and the wood anatomy, we interpreted cluster 7 as latewood or hardwood relatively little affected by aging.
Clusters 1 and 6 could represent earlywood relatively little affected by aging, or latewood or hardwood affected by aging. The evidence did not establish which of the two clusters was more affected.
blocks.zh:
第7组发生于软木晚期木材和硬木标本的内部. 它的光谱显示一个显式的第二个超光度的纤维素C-H拉伸(波段3),第一个超光度的O-H拉伸(7和9),以及与纤维素有关的组合波段(4、16和18)
(图,(a)和G.1)。
这些特征在第1和第6组中较弱,它们发生在软木早期木,部分后木,硬木内部.
基于这些分布和木质解剖学,我们把第7组解释为晚期木材或硬木相对较少受到老化的影响.
第1组和第6组可代表受老化影响相对较小的早期木材,或受老化影响的晚期木材或硬木. 证据没有确定这两个组中哪个组受影响较大。

blocks.en:
Cluster 5 also occurred in softwood earlywood and hardwood interiors (Figures (a) and G.1 ).
In the aggregated second-derivative spectra, the polysaccharide-related C–H bands (3, 4, 15, and 18) and O–H bands (5, 7, 9, and 16) were generally weaker in cluster 5 than in clusters 1, 6, and 7, whereas the aromatic C–H band (10) remained relatively distinct (Figure ).
These spectral features and their occurrence in the interior suggest that cluster 5 may represent wood affected by aging.
In softwoods, compression wood is rich in lignin and differs in polysaccharide composition [ 10 ] . It could produce similar features (Figure G.1 ), so pre-existing anatomical differences are another possible explanation.
blocks.zh:
第5组还出现在软木早期木材和硬木内部(图(a)和G.1 )。
在汇总的第二演化光谱中,与多沙克酰胺有关的C-H波段(3、4、15和18)和O-H波段(5、7、9和16)在第五组中一般比第1、6和7组弱,而芳香C-H波段(10)则相对不同(图)。
这些光谱特征及其在内部的出现表明,第5组可能代表受老化影响的木材。
在软木中,压缩木富含lignin,在聚沙克夏尔成分上有所不同[10]. 它可以产生类似的特征(图G.1),所以先前存在的解剖差异是另一种可能的解释.

blocks.en:
Cluster 4 occupied a localized interior region in the eaves support KYOw02751 and much of the measured surface in the column-base splice KYOw02789 (Figure (b)).
The end grain of the eaves support likely faced outward beneath the roof. Rainwater entering through the end grain could account for the localized distribution.
The column-base splice rested directly on a foundation stone, and the back of the specimen showed severe deterioration.
The use of Japanese chestnut ( Castanea crenata ), a species with naturally decay-resistant heartwood [ 34 ] , is also consistent with the damp conditions expected at this location.
These distributions, the positions of the members during service, and observations of the timbers led us to interpret cluster 4 as a state shaped by both aging and moisture exposure.
blocks.zh:
第4组占据着一个位于a的局部内部区域,支撑着KYOw02751和柱基支架中大部分测量到的表面KYOw02789(图(b)).
树枝的末粒 可能会在屋顶下方出现 雨水通过终端谷类进入,可能是局部分布的原因。
柱基的螺旋直接停留在一块奠基石上,标本的背面显示严重恶化.
日本栗属(学名:Castanea crenata)是具有自然耐腐性心木[34]的物种,其用途也符合该地预期的潮湿条件.
这些分布,成员在服役期间的位置,以及对木材的观察,使我们把第4组解释为一个既受老化影响,又受湿度影响而形成的状态。

blocks.en:
We chose clusters 1, 6, and 7 for the baseline because their cellulose-related features were more distinct than those of cluster 5 and their distributions spanned earlywood, latewood, and hardwood interiors.
We treated these clusters as candidates for relatively sound interior wood. The baseline provides a relative reference, and the wood it represents may itself have aged.
We compared cluster 5 with this baseline to examine the effects of aging, and clusters 5 and 4 with each other to examine the possible role of water (Figure 7 ).
blocks.zh:
我们选择了第1、第6和第7组作为基线,因为它们与纤维素有关的特征比第5组更为不同,它们的分布跨越早期木材、晚木和硬木内部。
我们把这些组群当作相对健全的内部木材的候选物。 基准提供了相对的参考,它所代表的木材本身可能已经老化。
我们将第5组与这一基线进行比较,以审查老化的影响,并将第5组和第4组相互进行比较,以审查水的可能作用(图7)。

blocks.en:
In all 41 specimens in which cluster 5 could be compared with the baseline, the specimen-specific relative band value for O–H in amorphous polysaccharides (band 5) was lower in cluster 5 than in the baseline for the same specimen.
For the bands associated with semicrystalline and crystalline cellulose, cluster 5 had lower values at both O–H stretching bands (7 and 9) in all 41 specimens and at the O–H and C–O stretching combination band (16) in 40 of 41.
Values for the cellulose-related C–H stretching band (3) and combination band (4) were also lower in cluster 5 in all 41 specimens.
Relative band values calculated from the means across specimens fell below the baseline at every polysaccharide-related C–H band (3, 4, 15, and 18) and O–H band (5, 7, 9, and 16) (Figure 7 ).
The corresponding values for lignin-related C–H bands 1 and 2 also fell below the baseline. The value for aromatic C–H (band 10) exceeded the baseline, although the direction of the difference varied among specimens.
blocks.zh:
在可与基线比较第5组的所有41个标本中,非形态聚沙酰胺(波段5)中O-H的标本特定相对波段值低于同一标本的基准值。
对于与半晶体和晶体纤维素有关的波段,第5组在所有41个标本中O-H拉伸波段(7和9)和在O-H和C-O拉伸波段(16个)的数值都较低。
纤维素相关C-H拉伸波段(3)和组合波段(4)的数值在所有41个标本中第5组也较低.
从各种标本中的手段计算出的相对波段值低于每个与多沙迦素有关的C-H波段(3、4、15和18)和O-H波段(5、7、9和16)的基准值(图7)。
与lignin相关的C-H波段1和2的相应值也低于基线。 芳香C-H(波段10)的价值超过了基线,尽管不同标本的差异方向不同.

blocks.en:
In second-derivative NIR transmission spectra, Tsuchikawa et al. [45] observed a shallower trough at 7000 cm -1 (within band 5) in wood from a historical Chamaecyparis obtusa pillar than in modern wood of the same species.
They attributed the weaker O–H band to a decrease in amorphous cellulose.
In NIR reflectance spectra, Yonenobu and Tsuchikawa [52] found no clear difference between historical and modern C. obtusa at the O–H bands associated with semicrystalline and crystalline cellulose (bands 7 and 9 here).
A compositional analysis of C. obtusa and Zelkova serrata from historical buildings in Japan found lower holocellulose contents in older wood [ 32 ] , consistent with the generally weaker polysaccharide-related C–H and O–H features in cluster 5.
Selective loss of amorphous polysaccharides alone is difficult to reconcile with the lower band values for cluster 5 at bands 7, 9, and 16 in nearly all of our within-specimen comparisons of interior regions.
Because the width of an absorption band also affects the depth of its second-derivative trough, we considered the hydrogen-bonding environment of O–H groups in the remaining cellulose.
blocks.zh:
在第二衍生国家清单报告传输光谱中,Tsuchikawa等人。 [45] 从历史上的Chamaecyparis obtusa柱上观察到的木材在7000 cm-1(在5波段内)比同一物种的现代木材更浅。
他们将较弱的O-H波段归因于无形态纤维素的减少.
在国家清单报告反射光谱中,Yonenobu和Tsuchikawa[52]在与半晶体和晶体纤维素有关的O-H波段(此处的波段7和9)中没有发现历史和现代C.obtusa之间的明显区别。
日本历史建筑对C. obtusa和Zelkova Serrata的构成分析发现,旧木质中含有的胡萝卜素含量较低[32],这与第5组中通常较弱的与多香草有关的C-H和O-H特征是一致的。
单是非形态性聚沙酰胺的选择性损失,就难以与第7、9和16组的低波段值相协调,这几乎是在我们几乎所有对内域的区间比较中。
由于吸收带的宽度也影响到其第二演化槽的深度,我们考虑了剩余纤维素中的O-H组的氢捆绑环境.

blocks.en:
Structural analyses of spruce wood suggest that cellulose chain packing and hydrogen bonding are more heterogeneous near the surface of an individual microfibril than in its core.
From their solid-state NMR results, the authors inferred that disordered cellulose chains were, on average, closer to regions containing hemicelluloses and lignin than well-ordered chains were [ 18 ] .
As hemicelluloses and lignin change during aging, their sites of contact with cellulose and other polymers may shift even when these constituents remain in the cell wall. Some of the intermolecular interactions that maintained their original arrangement, including hydrogen bonds, may then be lost.
We propose that this relaxes constraints both on cellulose chains near the microfibril surface and on the arrangement of adjacent microfibrils within a bundle.
Changes in the relative positions or orientations of neighboring chains within a microfibril could alter interchain hydrogen-bond distances and angles.
At the interface between adjacent microfibrils, changes in their spacing or in the orientation of their contacting faces could likewise alter the geometry in which an O–H group on one face can form a hydrogen bond with an oxygen atom on the other.
Greater variation in bond strength at both sites could broaden the O–H absorption bands. In cluster 5, this broadening, together with a smaller polysaccharide contribution, could account for the shallower second-derivative troughs at bands 7, 9, and 16.
blocks.zh:
对芽木的结构分析表明,纤维素链的包装和氢键结合在单个微纤维表面附近比其核心更为多样。
根据他们的固态NMR结果,提交人推断,有紊乱的纤维素链平均比有序链更接近含肝素和利格宁的区域[18]。
随着肝素和利格宁在衰老期间的变化,他们与纤维素和其他聚合物接触的地点即使这些成分留在细胞壁中,也可能发生改变。 某些维持其原始安排的分子间相互作用,包括氢键,随后可能会丢失.
我们提议,这既可放松对微纤维表面附近的纤维素链的限制,也可放松对捆绑内邻近微纤维的排列的限制。
邻链在微纤维内相对位置或方向的变化可能改变链间氢键距离和角度。
在相邻的微纤维之间的界面上,其间距或接触面的定向变化同样可以改变一个面的O-H组与另一个面的氧原子形成氢键的几何结构.
两个地点的债券强度差异较大,可以扩大O-H吸收带。 在第5组中,这种扩大加上较小的聚沙酰亚胺作用,可说明第7、9和16段较浅的第二演化槽。

blocks.en:
In the ten specimens in which clusters 4 and 5 could be compared directly, specimen-specific relative band values were higher in cluster 4 than in cluster 5 in eight specimens at band 7, eight at band 9, and seven at band 16. All three bands involve O–H stretching in semicrystalline or crystalline cellulose.
The value for bound water in the air-dry specimens (band 17) was higher in cluster 4 in nine of the ten specimens. Five specimens had higher values in cluster 4 at all four bands.
Relative band values calculated from the means across specimens were higher in cluster 4 than in cluster 5 at all polysaccharide-related O–H bands (5, 7, 9, and 16). At band 17, cluster 4 exceeded both cluster 5 and the baseline (Figure 7 ).
Among the polysaccharide-related C–H bands, cluster 4 had a lower relative band value at band 3, a similar value at band 4, and higher values at bands 15 and 18. Lignin C–H may also contribute to band 15, and band 18 may include a combination involving O–H.
blocks.zh:
在可直接比较第4组和第5组的10个标本中,第4组的标本特定相对波段值高于第5组的8个标本,第7组为第8个,第9组为第7个。 所有三个带都涉及O-H伸展在半晶体或晶体纤维素中.
空气干燥标本(Band 17)中的捆绑水值在10个标本中的9个第4组中较高. 五个标本在所有四个波段的第四组中具有更高的值.
根据所有与多沙查里德有关的O-H波段(5、7、9和16),第4组各波段的相对波段值高于第5组各波段。 在第17组,第4组既超过了第5组,也超过了基线(图7)。
在与多沙查里德相关的C-H频段中,第4组在第3段的相对波段值较低,第4段的相对值类似,第15和18段的相对值较高。 Lignin C-H也可能为乐队15作出贡献,乐队18可能包括一个涉及O-H的组合.

blocks.en:
The interior distribution of cluster 4 and the positions of the timbers in service suggest that water entering the wood may have flowed through cell lumina as free water, carrying soluble constituents produced during aging.
In beech that had been waterlogged for an extended period, solid-state NMR showed a smaller carbohydrate contribution relative to lignin than in modern beech. The authors attributed part of this difference to leaching of solubilized sugars [ 5 ] .
If leaching also changes cell-wall composition in structural timbers subject to intermittent water ingress, the O–H features of the remaining cellulose may become relatively more prominent.
Among the bands assigned to cellulose, those involving O–H stretching in semicrystalline or crystalline regions (7, 9, and 16) were stronger in cluster 4 than in cluster 5. By contrast, the C–H feature at band 3 was weaker in cluster 4, and the two clusters differed little at band 4.
To explain these differences among bands, we considered both changes in composition and the effect of the hydrogen-bonding environments of the remaining cellulose chains on absorption band shapes.
blocks.zh:
第4组的内部分布和正在使用的木材的位置表明,进入木材的水可能作为自由水通过细胞露米纳流出,携带在老化期间产生的可溶性成分。
在经过长时间的积水处理的海嘴中,固态NMR显示,与现代海嘴相比,碳水化合物的贡献较小。 提交人将这一差异部分归因于溶糖的浸出[5]。
如果浸出还会改变受间断性水侵影响的结构木材的细胞壁组成,剩余纤维素的O-H特征可能相对变得更加突出.
在分配给纤维素的带中,涉及半晶体或晶体区域(7、9和16)的O-H伸展的带在第4组比第5组强。 相比之下,第3组的C-H特性在第4组中较为弱小,在第4组中这两个组的差别很小.
为了解释波段之间的这些差异,我们既考虑了组成的变化,也考虑了剩余纤维素链的氢捆绑环境对吸收波段形状的影响.

blocks.en:
Historical poplar timber had a lower X-ray diffraction crystallinity index and a larger apparent crystallite diameter than modern wood of the same genus. The authors attributed the difference in crystallite diameter to local rearrangement of cellulose chains and also reported a higher equilibrium moisture content in the historical wood [ 23 ] .
For cluster 4, we assume that the relaxation of constraints during aging increased the variability in the relative positions and orientations of neighboring cellulose chains and in the orientations and spacing of microfibrils within a bundle.
In this state, repeated swelling and shrinkage of the cell wall during wetting and redrying could allow cellulose chains and microfibrils to move more readily. On redrying, some chains may rearrange, and hydrogen bonds may re-form between chains that move closer together.
Where adjacent microfibrils move closer together and become more regularly oriented and spaced, their hydroxyl-bearing faces may come into contact, allowing hydrogen bonds to re-form across the interface.
If redrying thus restores local order to arrangements disrupted during aging, hydrogen-bond distances and angles may be more uniform than in cluster 5, both between cellulose chains and between microfibrils.
A narrower range of hydrogen-bond strengths would also narrow the range of O–H stretching frequencies, concentrating absorption at each of bands 7, 9, and 16 over a narrower wavelength range and potentially producing deeper second-derivative troughs than in cluster 5.
blocks.zh:
历史上的Poplar木材的X射线疏松结晶指数较低,其表面晶体直径也比同一流派的现代木材大. 作者将晶体直径的差异归因于纤维素链的局部重排,还报告了历史木材中较高的平衡水分含量[23].
就第4组而言,我们假设,在老龄化期间放松限制增加了邻近纤维素链相对位置和方向的变异性,以及捆绑内微纤维的变异性和间距。
在这种状态下,细胞壁在湿润和重排时反复膨胀和萎缩,可以使纤维素链和微纤维更容易移动. 在重排时,一些链条可能会重新排列,氢键可能会在移动更紧密的链条之间重新形成.
如果相邻的微纤维更紧密地移动在一起,变得更经常的定向和间距,其含羟基的面孔可能会发生接触,使得氢键可以跨接口重新形成.
如果重排从而恢复局部秩序,恢复老化期间中断的安排,那么氢捆绑距离和角度可能比第5组更为一致,无论是纤维素链之间还是微纤维之间。
较窄的氢键强度范围也会缩小O-H拉伸频率的范围,将吸收集中在波段7、9和16的每个波段上,其波长范围较窄,并有可能产生比第5组更深的二演化槽。

blocks.en:
In a deuterium-exchange NIR study of historical C. obtusa wood, the water band was weaker than in modern wood, yet a larger fraction of the remaining O–H groups in amorphous and semicrystalline regions exchanged with D 2 O at saturation.
The authors suggested that changes in the relative arrangement of cellulose microfibrils could increase the fraction of remaining O–H groups accessible to water even as the total number of water sorption sites declined [ 45 ] .
In wood assigned to cluster 4, relaxation of the constraints between microfibrils could open gaps through which water reaches more of the remaining O–H groups inside a bundle. Leaching of soluble constituents could expose additional O–H groups.
Bound water retained at such interfaces in the air-dry state could help explain why the value for band 17 was higher in cluster 4 than in cluster 5.
blocks.zh:
在对历史的C. obtusa木材进行的脱氧核糖核酸交换国家清单报告中,水波段比现代木材要弱,然而,在非形态和半晶体区域剩余的O-H组中,有很大一部分在饱和时与D 2 O交换。
作者们认为,纤维素微纤维相对安排的变化,即使水吸附点总数减少,仍可增加剩余的O-H组水的一小部分。
在分配给第4组的木材中,微纤维之间的限制可以松动缺口,通过这些缺口,剩余的O-H组中的更多水可以到达捆绑区。 沥滤可溶性成分可能会暴露更多的O-H组别.
在空气干燥状态的这种界面中保留的界水有助于解释为什么第4组的波段值高于第5组。

blocks.en:
On this basis, we propose the following model of internal degradation, in which age-related changes in cell-wall constituents provide a common starting point.
During aging, slow hydrolysis and oxidation in cell walls containing sorbed moisture may alter the hemicelluloses and lignin surrounding individual cellulose microfibrils and their bundles.
We hypothesize that acetic acid released by hemicellulose deacetylation [ 26 ] can promote further hydrolysis of polysaccharide backbones if the acid remains in the wood. Some ether linkages in condensed lignin or lignin–carbohydrate complexes may also undergo hydrolysis [ 23 ] .
Even if the altered constituents remain in the cell wall, shifts in where the polymers contact one another and which groups form hydrogen bonds may disrupt some of the intermolecular interactions that maintain their arrangement. This would relax the constraints on cellulose chains near the microfibril surface. The surrounding polymers may also provide less support for a bundle, allowing adjacent microfibrils within it to change their relative positions and orientations more readily.
Greater variability in the relative positions and orientations of neighboring chains within the same microfibril could increase the variation in interchain hydrogen-bond distances and angles. Less regular orientations and spacing of the microfibrils within a bundle could likewise increase the variation in hydrogen-bond distances and angles across their interfaces.
The resulting broadening of NIR O–H absorption bands, together with a smaller contribution from polysaccharides, could produce shallower second-derivative O–H troughs associated with semicrystalline and crystalline regions.
blocks.zh:
在此基础上,我们提出以下内部退化模式,其中与年龄有关的细胞壁成分变化提供了一个共同的起点。
在老化期间,在含有吸附水的细胞壁中缓慢的水解和氧化可能会改变环绕单个纤维素微纤维及其捆绑的螺旋素和列宁.
我们假设,如果乙酸留在木材中,由乙酸脱羧[26] 释放的乙酸可以促进多沙克素骨干水解。 在缩合的碱基或碱基-碳水合物复合物中的某些乙醚连接也可能进行水解[23]。
即使改变的成分留在细胞壁中,在聚合物相互接触的地方以及形成氢键的哪个组会改变某些保持其排列的分子间相互作用。 这将放松微纤维表面附近纤维素链的束缚. 周围的聚合物也可能为捆绑提供较少的支持,使得其内相邻的微纤维可以更容易地改变它们的相对位置和方向.
同一微纤维内相邻链的相对位置和方向的较大变化可能增加链间氢键距离和角度的变化。 捆绑内微纤维的固定方向和间距较少,同样会增加其界面上氢键距离和角度的变化。
由此扩大国家清单报告O-H吸收波段,加上聚沙酰胺的较小贡献,可以产生与半晶体和晶体区域有关的较浅的二演化O-H槽。

blocks.en:
Where water enters the wood through the end grain along the L direction or through cracks and joints, as may occur during rainfall, soluble constituents produced during aging can dissolve out of the cell wall and be carried away by free water flowing through the cell lumina. This leaching changes the composition of the material that remains in the cell wall.
Where aging has relaxed the constraints on cellulose, swelling and shrinkage of the cell wall during wetting and redrying can change both the relative positions and orientations of neighboring chains and the spacing and orientations of microfibrils within a bundle.
During redrying, some chains may rearrange and hydrogen bonds may re-form between neighboring chains. Where constraints have relaxed, cell-wall shrinkage may also draw adjacent microfibrils closer together and tighten the bundle locally.
If this partially restores the order disrupted during aging and brings opposing hydroxyl-bearing faces into contact, hydrogen bonds may also re-form across the interface.
A narrower range of distances and angles among the re-formed hydrogen bonds would reduce the variation in bond strength. This could narrow each absorption band to which O–H stretching in semicrystalline or crystalline regions contributes, producing more distinct troughs in the second-derivative NIR spectra.
At the same time, relaxation of the constraints between microfibrils may open gaps to water, increasing the fraction of remaining O–H groups accessible even inside a bundle. Leaching of nearby soluble constituents may expose further O–H groups to water.
These more accessible interfaces can coexist with locally ordered regions and may retain bound water in the air-dry state.
blocks.zh:
当水通过沿L方向的端粒或通过裂缝和关节进入木质时,如在降雨期间可能发生的情况,在老化期间产生的可溶性成分可以溶解出细胞壁,被流经细胞 Lumina的自由水带走. 这种浸出会改变细胞壁中残留的材料的构成.
衰老时放松了对纤维素的限制,在湿润和重修时细胞壁的膨胀和收缩,既可以改变邻链的相对位置和方向,也可以改变捆绑内微纤维的间隔和方向.
在重排过程中,一些链条可能重新排列,氢键可能在相邻的链条之间重新形成. 在限制放松的情况下,细胞壁收缩也可能将相邻的微纤维拉近,并在当地收紧捆绑.
如果这部分还原了衰老时中断的订单,并使对立的羟基含面发生接触,氢键也可能重新形成跨接口.
重新形成的氢键之间的距离和角度范围缩小,将减少债券强度的变化。 这会缩小半晶体或晶体区域O-H的吸收带,在第二衍生国家清单报告谱中产生更独特的槽。
同时,微纤维之间的限制松动可能会打开水的缺口,从而增加即使是在捆绑内也能接触到的剩余O-H组的一小部分。 附近易溶成分的沥滤可能会进一步使O-H群体暴露在水中。
这些更容易获取的界面可以与当地订购的区域共存,并可能在空气干燥状态下保留捆绑的水.

blocks.en:
Even in specimens from different sources and timber member types, clusters 3 and 8 formed contiguous regions within a few millimeters of edges inferred to correspond to surfaces exposed during service
(Figures (b) and G.1 ).
For cluster 3 in the outermost layer, the relative band values calculated from the means across specimens for lignin-related C–H bands 1 and 2 were substantially below the interior baseline (Figure 9 ).
Lignin oxidation has been suggested in the surface layers of naturally weathered wood [ 43 ] .
The occurrence of cluster 3 along exposed surfaces and the weaker bands 1 and 2, consistent with lignin alteration during natural weathering, led us to interpret it as a region strongly affected by weathering.
blocks.zh:
即使在来自不同来源和木材成员类型的标本中,第3组和第8组在几毫米边缘范围内形成毗连区,推断与服役期间暴露的表面相对应。
(图(b)和G.1)。
对于最外层的第3组,从与lignin有关的C-H波段1和2的标本的跨度所计算的相对波段值大大低于内部基线(图9)。
在自然风化木质的表层中提出了利金氧化法[43].
第3组沿着暴露的表面和较弱的波段1和2的出现,与自然风化过程中的列宁变化一致,导致我们把它解释为受到风化严重影响的区域.

blocks.en:
In cluster 3, the relative band value for the cellulose C–H combination band 4 was also substantially below the interior baseline (Figure 9 ).
In naturally weathered radiata pine veneers, the solution viscosity of holocellulose isolated from the entire veneer thickness decreased. The authors interpreted this as a decrease in the degree of polymerization of cellulose [ 13 ] .
We consider that both leaching of soluble fractions produced by polysaccharide depolymerization and changes in the supramolecular structure of the polysaccharides remaining in the cell wall contributed to the weaker band 4 in cluster 3.
blocks.zh:
在第3组中,纤维素C-H组合带4的相对带值也大大低于内部基线(图9)。
在自然风化的散热松花膜中,从整个花膜厚度中分离出来的黄素的溶液粘度下降。 作者将此解释为纤维素聚合程度的下降[13].
我们认为,聚沙酰胺脱聚产生的可溶性碎片的浸出和细胞壁中残留的聚沙酰胺的超分子结构的变化,都造成了第3组中较弱的波段4。

blocks.en:
In some specimens, cluster 8 occurred immediately inward of cluster 3 (Figure (b)).
The relative band values for cluster 8 calculated from the means across specimens were below the baseline and above cluster 3 at all 13 selected bands (Figure 9 ).
In both clusters 3 and 8, the relative band values within the polysaccharide-related C–H group were higher at bands 15 and 18 than at bands 3 and 4.
In cluster 8, the polysaccharide-related O–H bands (5, 7, 9, and 16) had relative band values below the baseline, whereas band 17, attributed to bound water in the air-dry specimens, was close to the baseline.
Band 6, where water and polysaccharide absorptions overlap, weakened similarly to the adjacent polysaccharide-related band 5.
blocks.zh:
在一些标本中,第8组立即出现在第3组内部(图(b))。
从所有13个选定的波段中,从各种标本中计算出来的第8组的相对波段值低于基线,高于第3组(图9)。
在两个组的第3组和第8组中,与多沙克夏尔相关的C-H组中的相对波段值在15和18组中高于3和4组。
在第八组中,与多沙迦化物有关的O-H波段(5、7、9和16)的波段值低于基线,而与空气干燥标本中的捆绑水有关的波段17则接近基线。
6号带,水和聚沙酰胺的吸收发生重叠,与相邻的多沙酰胺相关的5号带类似弱化.

blocks.en:
The baseline and both clusters could be compared within the same specimen in 46 specimens.
The number of specimens in which the relative band value decreased in the order baseline, cluster 8, and cluster 3 ranged from 41 to 46 for cellulose-related C–H (3) and polysaccharide-related O–H (5, 7, and 9), and was 30 for the O–H and C–O combination band (16).
The corresponding counts for aromatic C–H (10) and bound water (17) were 25 and 24. In some specimens, cluster 8 exceeded the baseline for that specimen at these bands.
The tendency for polysaccharide-related features to lie between those of cluster 3 and the interior baseline, together with the location immediately inward of cluster 3, led us to interpret cluster 8 in this spatial arrangement as a transition region in chemical state associated with weathering of the outermost layer.
blocks.zh:
在46个标本中,可以在同一标本内对基线和两个集群进行比较。
按基线、第8组和第3组排列,相对波段值下降的标本数量从41至46不等,与纤维素有关的C-H(3)和与多沙克酸盐有关的O-H(5、7和9),O-H和C-O组合波段为30(16)。
芳香C-H(10)和捆绑水(17)的相应计数分别为25和24。 在一些标本中,第8组超过了这些标本的基线.
聚沙酰胺相关特征往往位于第3组和内部基线之间,再加上第3组紧接在内部的位置,因此,我们对这一空间安排中的第8组作了解释,将其解释为与最外层风化有关的化学状态过渡区域。

blocks.en:
In Figure (b), clusters 3 and 8 occurred within a few millimeters of the specimen edges (Figure G.1 ).
Where a radial or tangential face had been exposed, this width corresponds to the depth inward from the side of the timber member.
Kataoka et al. exposed radial faces of Cryptomeria japonica and Chamaecyparis obtusa earlywood to xenon light for 50–1500 h. They found a logarithmic relationship between irradiation time and the depth at which a change in the FT-IR carbonyl band at 1730 cm -1 could be detected [ 30 ] .
They estimated that the energy received during 1500 h of irradiation was approximately equivalent to 10–11 months of natural exposure on a horizontal surface in Tokyo.
Using this conversion to extrapolate the regressions in their Figure 4 from the equivalent of 100 years to 400 years gives depths increasing from approximately 1.4 to 1.6 mm for C. japonica earlywood and from 0.9 to 1.1 mm for C. obtusa earlywood.
Because the actual light exposure and erosion by wind and rain at the sides of the timber members are unknown, we used these estimates only to compare the order of magnitude of the depths.
The occurrence of a weathered outermost layer and an adjacent transition region within a few millimeters of the side is compatible with this estimate.
blocks.zh:
在图(b)中,第3组和第8组发生在标本边缘数毫米内(图G.1 )。
在露出光圈或微小面孔的地方,这一宽度相当于从木材成员侧面向内的深度。
Kataoka等人将Cryptomeria japonica和Chamaecyparis obtusa 早期木材的光圈面孔暴露于xenon光线50-1500 h. 他们发现了辐照时间与深度之间的对数关系,在1730 cm -1的FT-IR碳酰带中可以检测到变化[30].
他们估计,在1500小时辐照期间获得的能量大约相当于在东京横向表面自然暴露10-11个月。
利用这种转换推算其图4中的回归值,从100年到400年,使C. Japonica早期木材的深度从大约1.4毫米增加到1.6毫米,C. obtusa早期木材从0.9毫米增加到1.1毫米。
由于木材成员侧面的实际轻度暴露和受风雨侵蚀的情况不明,我们只用这些估计来比较深度的大小顺序.
最外层风化和在几毫米内邻近过渡区域的出现与这一估计相符。

blocks.en:
In Figure (a), however, cluster 8 occupied a broad area of the measured surface located 10 mm inward from an end-grain surface inferred to have been exposed.
In Figure (c), clusters 3 and 8 occurred around insect holes in KYOw02772, and cluster 8 extended into an interior region containing insect holes in KYOw16702.
The depth of photodegradation from an exposed side face alone is unlikely to explain the occurrence of cluster 8 on the plane 10 mm inward from exposed end grain or its inward extent in regions containing insect holes.
We therefore considered water ingress through the end grain or insect galleries as a factor common to these two cases.
blocks.zh:
然而,在图(a)中,第8组在测量表层中占据了大面积,该表层位于从一个被推断暴露的末端地表向内10毫米处。
在图(c)中,第3和第8组发生在KYOw02772的昆虫洞周围,第8组延伸至KYOw16702的内地含有昆虫洞。
光照侧面光降解的深度不可能解释10毫米平面上第8组从暴露的末粒向内或从含有昆虫孔的区域向内发生。
因此,我们认为,通过终端谷物或昆虫廊进水是这两种情况的共同因素。

blocks.en:
Where end grain is exposed, water can enter open cell lumina and penetrate deeper along the L direction.
Where insect damage occurs near a surface, galleries connected to the exterior of the original timber member can provide routes for water ingress.
The entrance need not lie on the measured transverse surface. A gallery extending out of the observation plane may connect to the exterior elsewhere.
Water entering through end grain or insect galleries may thus have helped shape the chemical state of the wood in regions assigned to cluster 8 at these locations.
blocks.zh:
在端粒暴露的地方,水可以进入开放的细胞 Lumina,沿着L方向渗入更深.
如果昆虫损害发生在地表附近,与原木材成员外部相连的画廊可以提供进水的路线.
入口不必位于测量到的横向表面。 展出观察飞机的画廊可以连接到其他地方的外部.
因此,通过终端谷物或昆虫画廊进入的水可能有助于在这些地点分配到第8组的区域形成木材的化学状态。

blocks.en:
If water enters a transition region where the direct effects of light and raindrops are weak, we might expect aging and moisture exposure to produce a chemical state similar to that inferred for regions assigned to cluster 4.
Figure , however, includes examples in which cluster 8 lies inward of cluster 3.
Among the 12 specimens in which clusters 4 and 8 could be compared within the same specimen, the specimen-level relative band value for aromatic C–H (10) was lower in cluster 8 in nine specimens. In contrast, the values for lignin-related C–H bands 1 and 2 were lower in cluster 4 in ten specimens each.
For the polysaccharide-related O–H group and bound water in the air-dry specimens (17), which cluster had the higher value varied among specimens.
blocks.zh:
如果水进入过渡区域,而该地区的光和雨滴的直接影响较弱,我们可能期望老化和湿度的暴露会产生类似于分配给第4组的区域所推断的化学状态。
然而,图中包括第8组内在第3组的例子。
在可在同一标本内比较第4组和第8组的12个标本中,芳香C-H(10)的标本级相对波段值低于第8组的9个标本。 相比之下,与lignin相关的C-H波段1和2的值在每组10个标本的第4组中较低。
对于与多沙查里德有关的O-H组和空气干燥标本中的捆绑水(17),该标本的价值较高。

blocks.en:
We propose that leaching and transport of soluble constituents by free water, together with wetting and redrying of the cell wall, helped shape the chemical states represented by clusters 4 and 8.
In regions assigned to cluster 4, free water flowing through cell lumina can leach soluble constituents produced during aging, changing the sites of contact between the polymers remaining in the cell wall.
We proposed that these changes, combined with local rearrangement during wetting and redrying, alter the supramolecular structure of the remaining constituents.
Where regions assigned to cluster 8 adjoin the weathered outer layer (cluster 3), water entering the wood may also carry acidic products from that layer into these regions.
Spectra measured before and after water extraction of photodegraded wood showed that photodegradation products containing carboxyl groups could be removed by water [ 44 ] .
In artificial weathering with light and water spray, changes in lignin were also observed on the lumen side of the outermost tracheid walls. The authors discussed erosion of the thickened centers of bordered pit membranes (tori). They attributed the lignin changes in part to leaching of degradation products by spray water entering the lumina through microcracks originating at the pit apertures [ 29 ] .
If some products remain in the cell wall after drying interrupts water flow, they may promote secondary reactions, including hydrolysis of cell-wall constituents, upon rewetting.
Secondary reactions superimposed on these shared processes may help explain why the chemical state of the transition region differs from that of the wood assigned to cluster 4.
blocks.zh:
我们提议,通过自由水浸出和运送可溶性成分,加上细胞壁的湿润和重修,有助于形成以第4和第8组为代表的化学状态。
在分配到第4组的区域,通过细胞露米纳自由流出的水可以浸出老化过程中产生的可溶性成分,改变细胞壁中残留的聚合物之间的接触点.
我们提议,这些变化,加上湿润和重排时的局部重新安排,应改变其余成分的超分子结构。
在被分配到第8组附着风化外层的区域(第3组),进入木材的水也可能将该层的酸性产品运入这些区域。
光降解木材取水前后测得的光谱显示,含有碳酸盐组的光降解产品可以通过水清除[44].
在使用灯光和水喷雾进行人工风化时,在最外侧的气管壁的路门侧也观察到了利格宁的变化. 提交人讨论了边界坑膜(Tori)加厚中心受到侵蚀的问题。 他们将利宁的变化部分归因于通过喷水渗入来自坑孔径的微架进入露米纳的降解产物的沥滤[29]。
如果一些产物在干燥后仍留在细胞壁中会中断水流,它们可能会促进二次反应,包括细胞壁成分的水解,一旦再湿化.
在这些共享过程上叠加的二次反应可能有助于解释为什么过渡区域的化学状态不同于分配给第4组的木材。

blocks.en:
On this basis, we propose the following model of surface degradation.
In the outermost layer, light alters lignin and other constituents, and wind and rain erode the weakened tissue. Rainwater leaches soluble lignin-derived products and soluble fractions of depolymerized polysaccharides. We propose that these losses, together with changes in the supramolecular structure of the remaining polysaccharides, weaken both lignin-related and polysaccharide-related bands.
Some soluble acidic products formed by weathering of the outermost layer leave the timber with rainwater, while others are transported inward by water entering the wood. A transition region in chemical state associated with weathering of the outermost layer forms where the transported acidic products remain in the cell wall and promote secondary reactions upon rewetting.
blocks.zh:
在此基础上,我们提出以下表面退化模式.
在最外层,光会改变列宁和其他成分,风雨侵蚀弱小的组织. 雨水落叶液可溶于利格宁衍生产物和可溶性分解的多糖沙酰胺. 我们提议,这些损失,加上剩余聚沙酰胺的超分子结构的变化,削弱与利尼和多沙酰胺有关的波段。
一些通过最外层风化形成的可溶性酸性产物让木材留下雨水,而另一些则通过水运入木材. 与最外层风化有关的化学状态过渡区域,运输的酸性产物留在细胞壁中,并在再湿化时促进二次反应。

blocks.en:
The transition region shares the basic processes described in the internal degradation model , including age-related alteration of polysaccharides and lignin, leaching of soluble constituents by free water, and local rearrangement during wetting and redrying of the cell wall.
An additional process supplies acidic products formed by weathering of the outermost layer through water entering the wood. Products retained in the cell wall may promote secondary reactions upon rewetting, including hydrolysis of glycosidic linkages in polysaccharides and some ether linkages involving lignin.
Because photodegradation from direct irradiation and erosion by wind and rain are less pronounced in the transition region, polysaccharide-related spectral features are expected to be better preserved there than in the outermost layer.
Changes in the supramolecular structure of the remaining constituents can make hydrogen-bonding environments more heterogeneous, broadening polysaccharide-related O–H absorption bands in the NIR and producing shallower second-derivative troughs.
As in the internal degradation model, regions with increased water accessibility to the remaining O–H groups may retain bound water in the air-dry state.
blocks.zh:
过渡区域与内部退化模型中描述的基本过程相同,其中包括与年龄有关的聚沙酰胺和利格宁的改变、通过自由水浸出可溶性成分,以及湿化和重修细胞壁时的局部重排。
另有一种工艺通过水进入木头,使最外层风化形成酸性产品。 细胞壁中保留的产品在再湿化时可能促进二次反应,包括聚沙沙酰胺中的甘化物连接水解和一些涉及丁醇的乙醚连接。
由于过渡区域受直接辐照和风雨侵蚀所产生的光降解不太明显,因此预计那里的与多沙查里德有关的光谱特征比最外层保存得更好。
剩余成分的超分子结构的变化可以使氢碱环境更加多样化,扩大国家清单报告中与多沙克酰胺有关的O-H吸收带,并产生较浅的二次衍生槽。
与内部退化模型一样,剩余的O-H水组获得水的机会增加的地区,可能保留空气干燥状态下的捆绑水。

blocks.en:
The depth of the transition region depends on the anisotropy of water penetration and the pathways from exposed surfaces into the timber.
Water entering inward from a radial face travels mainly in the T direction, while water entering from a tangential face travels mainly in the R direction. Both directions lie within the measured transverse plane and cross the long axes of the cells.
The lumina of tracheids and vessels extend along the grain, and water moves more readily along these lumina in the L direction than in the R or T direction. Thus, when water entering from a side face in the R or T direction reaches cell lumina through pits or microcracks enlarged by wetting and redrying, some of it may be diverted into the L direction, perpendicular to the measured transverse plane.
We propose that this diversion limits how far the products supplied from the side face reach into the timber.
Where end grain is exposed, water enters in the L direction and can transport products deeper than when it enters in the R or T direction. If an insect gallery extending out of the measured transverse plane connects to the exterior elsewhere on the timber member, products can also be supplied along that route to the vicinity of insect holes that lie away from the edges in the observed plane.
Regardless of the entry route, uptake and retention of some acidic products in the cell walls reduce the amount supplied farther inward.
When drying interrupts water movement, product transport also ceases, and some of the products retained in the cell wall can remain locally.
Upon rewetting, these residual products promote secondary reactions such as hydrolysis.
We propose that the water entry routes and diversion of flow, combined with retention of products and interruption of transport by drying, alter the extent of secondary reactions and give rise to transition regions of different depths.
blocks.zh:
过渡区域的深度取决于水的渗透程度和从暴露的表面进入木材的路径。
从光圈面向内进入的水主要在T方向行驶,而从微小的面向内进入的水主要在R方向行驶. 两个方向都位于测量的横平面内,并跨越细胞的长轴.
气管和船只的润滑油沿着谷物延伸,水沿着这些润滑油沿着L方向移动比沿着R或T方向移动更容易。 因此,当从R或T方向的侧面进入的水通过水坑或因湿润和重染而膨胀的微架到达细胞 Lumina时,部分水可能会分流到L方向,与测量到的横面垂直。
我们提议,这一转移将限制从侧面供应的产品进入木材的距离。
在端粒暴露的地方,水会进入L方向,并且可以比进入R或T方向时更深地运输产品. 如果从测量的横面平面延伸出来的昆虫画廊连接到木材成份上其他地方的外部,那么产品也可以沿着该路线供应到远离观测到的平面边缘的昆虫洞附近.
无论进入途径如何,在细胞壁中吸收和保留一些酸性产品会减少向内供应的数量。
当干燥中断水运动时,产品运输也停止,一些留在细胞壁中的产品可以留在当地.
在再湿后,这些残留产物会促进水解等二级反应.
我们建议,水的入水路线和流量的分流,加上产品的保留和干燥造成的运输中断,改变二次反应的程度,引起不同深度的过渡区域.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
Where a chemical state occurs, how far it extends, and whether it recurs in specimens with different histories can offer clues to how it formed.
We examined this question in historical timber, where centuries of environmental exposure are superimposed on chemical differences among anatomical regions.
To compare these distributions without defining chemical-state categories in advance, we developed ChemoMAE, a self-supervised method that exploits dependencies among near-infrared (NIR) bands through masked denoising.
We applied ChemoMAE to pixel spectra obtained by near-infrared hyperspectral imaging (NIR-HSI) and used the learned representations for unsupervised segmentation.
Across the cluster counts examined, ChemoMAE consistently yielded higher mean Local Label Agreement (LLA) on held-out specimens than direct use of the input spectra, PCA, and the conventional autoencoder baselines.
Additional perturbations designed to preserve the zero mean and fixed norm of spectra after standard normal variate (SNV) transformation contributed little to this LLA advantage.
They may nevertheless help suppress fine-scale artifacts in spatial maps, including linear patterns associated with the scanning direction.
blocks.zh:
化学状态发生的地方,其延伸有多远,以及它是否在具有不同历史的标本中重现,可以提供如何形成它的线索.
我们在历史木材中研究了这个问题,在这些木材中,数百年的环境暴露在解剖区之间的化学差异之上。
为了在不预先定义化学状态类别的情况下比较这些分布,我们开发了ChemoMAE,这是一种自我监督的方法,通过蒙面去诺来利用近红外波段的依赖性.
我们把ChemoMAE应用于近红外超光谱成像(NIR-HSI)获得的像素谱,并将所学到的表达用于无监督的分解.
在所审查的集群计数中,ChemoMAE在搁置标本上得出的平均地方标签协议一直高于直接使用输入谱、五氯苯甲醚和常规自动编码基线。
在标准正常变异(SNV)变异后,为保持光谱的零平均值和固定规范而设计的额外扰动对这个LLA的优势作用不大.
不过,它们可能有助于压制空间地图中的细度文物,包括与扫描方向有关的线性图案。

blocks.en:
We used prior knowledge of wood anatomy and degradation to specify a property expected of a useful spectral representation.
If regions of similar chemical state span neighboring pixels and the spectral features that distinguish those regions are shared across specimens, clustering spectra alone should yield spatially coherent regions in an unseen specimen.
We therefore withheld spatial information from both representation learning and clustering and used it to test this prediction.
We formulated LLA to measure neighboring-label agreement after correcting for chance at fixed cluster sizes and showed that it equals one minus the variance-weighted mean of Geary’s C C across binary cluster indicators.
Specimen-level cross-validation revealed that the unmasked denoising autoencoder achieved spatial coherence comparable to ChemoMAE on the specimens used for fitting, yet generalized less well to held-out specimens.
The comparison with PCA also depended on the evaluation criterion.
PCA gave a higher cosine-silhouette score, while ChemoMAE gave higher mean LLA on held-out specimens.
For chemical interpretation using hyperspectral images, the emergence of spatial structure consistent with material knowledge in unseen specimens thus provides one basis for evaluating a learned representation.
blocks.zh:
我们利用以前对木材解剖学和退化的了解,具体指明了预期有用光谱表示的财产。
如果具有类似化学状态的区域横跨相邻的像素,而区分这些区域的光谱特征在标本之间共享,单聚光谱就应在一个看不见的标本中产生空间连贯的区域。
因此,我们不提供空间信息,不让进行代表性学习和集群,而是利用这种信息测试这种预测。
我们制定了LLA来测量邻邻标签协议,
标本层的交叉验证显示,在用于装配的标本上,无假发解码自动编码器实现了与ChemoMAE相似的空间一致性,但对于被搁置的标本而言,其普遍性较差.
与常设仲裁法院的比较也取决于评价标准。
PCA给出了更高的大同分数,而Chemo MAE在搁置标本上给出了更高的平均法学硕士学位。
就利用超光谱图像进行化学解释而言,在未见标本中出现与物质知识相一致的空间结构,因此为评价所学表现提供了一种基础。

blocks.en:
We learned the representation and fitted common cluster centers anew across 49 specimens representing seven wood taxa from several historical buildings in Japan.
The resulting atlas links each specimen’s provenance, timber member type, and wood taxon to its spatial map and regional second-derivative NIR spectra.
By cross-referencing specimens, we identified similarities and differences in the spatial distributions of clusters and interpreted them in light of their spectra, the members’ service histories, and prior studies.
These comparisons led us to propose two degradation models.
In the internal degradation model, aging makes hydrogen-bonding environments around cellulose microfibrils more heterogeneous.
Where water enters, leaching changes the constituents that remain, and repeated wetting and drying may promote local rearrangement.
In the surface degradation model, water carries soluble acidic products from the weathered outer layer into the wood.
Products retained in cell walls may promote secondary reactions upon rewetting, giving rise to a transition region beneath the surface.
Together, the atlas and the models offer a guide to where to look and what to test in other historical timbers.
The atlas can help researchers locate regions potentially affected by weathering, choose depths for chemical sampling, or select sites from which to cut specimens for mechanical testing.
The models suggest what to examine at those sites.
For example, anatomically comparable interior regions with and without indications of past water ingress could be sampled to examine whether differences in apparent cellulose crystallinity measured by X-ray diffraction are accompanied by differences in hydroxyl accessibility measured by deuterium exchange.
Sampling across the boundary of a mapped transition region beneath a weathered surface could test whether water extracts from that region have a lower pH than those from the adjacent interior.
blocks.zh:
我们从日本的几座历史建筑学到了49个标本,
由此产生的地图集将每个标本的出处、木材成员类型和木材分类与其空间图和区域二级国家清单报告谱联系起来。
通过相互参照的标本,我们发现了集群空间分布的相似之处和差异,并根据它们的谱系、成员服务历史和以往的研究来解释。
这些比较导致我们提出了两个降解模型。
在内部降解模型中,衰老使得纤维素微纤维周围的氢捆绑环境更加多样化.
当水进入时,浸出会改变留下的成分,反复的湿润和干燥可能会促进局部的重排.
在地表降解模型中,水从风化的外层携带可溶性酸性产物进入木材.
细胞壁中保留的产品在再湿后可能促进二次反应,导致表面以下的过渡区域.
地图集和模型共同提供了在其他历史木材中寻找和测试的指南。
地图集可以帮助研究人员找到可能受风化影响的区域,选择深度进行化学取样,或者选择从中切除标本进行机械测试的地点.
这些模型建议在这些地点检查什么。
例如,可以对有和无过去水侵迹象的具有解剖可比性的内部区域进行取样,以检查用X射线衍射测量的表面纤维素结晶度的差异是否伴随着通过脱氧交换测量的羟基可得性的差异。
在经过风化的地表下跨经测绘的过渡区域边界取样,可以检验该区域提取的水的pH值是否低于邻近的内地。

blocks.en:
In this exploratory AI for Science framework, self-supervised learning gives researchers a common basis for comparing observations whose chemical meaning is initially uncertain.
An interpretation suggested by a region’s spectrum can be examined against where similar features recur in other specimens, how far they extend, and which regions they adjoin.
Shared patterns can support an interpretation, while differences can prompt researchers to ask what additional process might explain a particular distribution.
The open-source chemomae library, experimental code, and configurations make the learning and evaluation procedures available for studies of other materials.
In historical wood, we demonstrated how researchers can evaluate patterns learned from unlabeled spectra against expectations drawn from material knowledge, then connect observations across diverse specimens with prior findings to formulate testable hypotheses about how material states arise.
blocks.zh:
在这个探索性的AI for Science框架中,自我监督的学习为研究者提供了比较其化学意义最初不确定的观测结果的共同基础.
可以从一个区域的频谱来研究类似特征在其他标本中重复出现的地方、其延伸程度以及它们相邻的区域。
共享模式可以支持一种解释,而差异则可以促使研究者询问,什么额外过程可以解释某一特定分布.
开源化疗库,实验代码,以及配置使学习和评价程序可用于其他材料的研究.
在历史木材中,我们演示了研究人员如何对照从物质知识中得出的期望来评价从无标签光谱中吸取的规律,然后将不同标本上的观测结果与先前的研究结果联系起来,以形成关于材料状态如何产生的可测试假设。

blocks.en: CRediT authorship contribution statement

blocks.en: C.1 Wavelength Selection and Quality Control
blocks.zh: C.1 波长选择和质量控制

blocks.en:
In bands where the difference between the white and dark references is small, errors in the measurements or references have a greater effect on reflectance because this difference is the denominator in the reflectance calculation.
To select the wavelength range, we computed the ratio of the mean to the standard deviation across columns v v of the reference difference Δ v , c = w v , c − d v , c \Delta_{v,c}=w_{v,c}-d_{v,c} at band c c .
We defined this proxy for the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) as SNR proxy ​ ( c ) = Mean v ⁡ ( Δ v , c ) Std v ⁡ ( Δ v , c ) + 10 − 12 \mathrm{SNR}_{\mathrm{proxy}}(c)=\frac{\operatorname{Mean}_{v}(\Delta_{v,c})}{\operatorname{Std}_{v}(\Delta_{v,c})+10^{-12}} (C.1) where Std v \operatorname{Std}_{v} is the standard deviation without a degrees-of-freedom correction and 10 − 12 10^{-12} guards against division by zero.
Variation across columns can reflect both spatial nonuniformity and measurement noise, so this proxy differs from an SNR based on temporal variation in repeated measurements.

为了选择波长范围,我们计算出平均值与第V栏标准偏差之比。

blocks.en:
Starting at the long-wavelength end, we excluded consecutive bands for which the proxy was nonfinite or at most 10.
We chose the threshold of 10 empirically by inspecting the reference signal as a function of wavelength, to exclude the low values following the sharp drop near 2300 nm.
The last retained band was at 2305.59 nm and the first excluded band was at 2311.85 nm. Figure C.1 marks their midpoint, 2308.72 nm, as the cutoff.

最后一个保留乐队是2305.59nm,第一个被排除在外的乐队是2311.85nm. 图C.1标注了它们的中点,2308.72 nm,作为截断点.

blocks.en:
We resampled the spectra and evaluated pixel quality as described in Section 3.3 .
Reflectance was calculated without adding a small constant to the denominator or clipping the result to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] .
We also excluded pixels with any nonfinite reflectance values after interpolation.
blocks.zh:
如第3.3节所述,我们重印了光谱并评估了像素质量。
计算反射时没有在分母上添加一个小的常数,也没有将结果剪切到[0, 1] [0, 1].
我们还排除了内插后任何非无限反射值的像素.

C.2 Model Settings Table C.1 lists the model settings shared by A0, A1, M00–M11, and the supplementary mask ratio conditions M11-25 and M11-75. Table C.1: Model settings common to the AE, denoising AE, and ChemoMAE. Parameter Value Input channels 256 Patches 16 Channels per patch 16 Encoder embedding dimension 256 Encoder layers 8 Attention heads 8 Feed-forward hidden dimension 1024 Dropout rate 0 Latent dimension 16 We initialized the CLS token and positional embeddings from a truncated normal distribution with the standard deviation parameter set to 0.02.
For linear layers, the weight initialization used a uniform distribution whose range depended on the input dimension.
For the query, key, and value weights in attention, we used Xavier uniform initialization.
LayerNorm scales were initialized to one and biases to zero.
All encoder layers were initialized with identical parameter values and then optimized jointly, with separate parameters for each layer. Table C.1 lists the settings that differed by condition.
M11-25 and M11-75 are the supplementary conditions for the mask ratio comparison in Appendix E.3 .
In that comparison, M11(-50) denotes the main M11 condition.
The supplementary comparison under full-dataset fitting used M11(-50) and M11-75 (Appendix E.3.2 ).
The loss was the mean squared error over the specified target channels, without further normalization within patches. blocks.en:
For full-dataset fitting, we held the representations for each condition and the common set of fitting pixels fixed.
We ran Cosine-KMeans three times at K = 8 K=8 , using the same sequence of initialization seeds across the six main conditions and the supplementary condition M11-75.
All three repetitions contributed to the quantitative summaries. The maps show the first clustering result, as specified in advance.
blocks.zh:
为了配齐完整的数据集,我们持有每个条件的表示以及通用的配齐像素集固定.
我们以K = 8 K = 8 的成绩3次运行了Cosine-KMEANs,使用相同顺序的初始化种子跨越6个主要条件和补充条件M11-75.

blocks.en: C.5 PCA Settings
blocks.zh: C.5 五氯苯甲醚 设置

blocks.en: We used the covariance_eigh solver in scikit-learn for PCA, retaining 16 principal components without additional wavelength-wise standardization or whitening.
blocks.zh: 我们在Scikit-learn中使用了共振解析器,保留了16个主要组件,而没有增加波长标准化或白化。

blocks.en: C.6 Evaluation Conventions
blocks.zh: C.6 评价公约

blocks.en:
We used the common specimen sets defined in Section 5.2.3 , without imputing undefined values.
We required at least one specimen to compute an aggregate and at least two to compute the between-specimen sample standard deviation.
LLA was undefined for fewer than two valid pixels, for an empty set of valid neighboring pairs, or when assignment to a single cluster gave P s = 1 P_{s}=1 .
blocks.zh:
我们使用了第5.2.3节中定义的通用标本集,而没有估算未定义的值。
我们要求至少一个标本来计算一个集合,至少两个标本来计算光谱之间标准差.
LLA对于少于两个有效像素,对于一组空有效邻对,或者对单个集群的指派给P s = 1 P_{s}=1 时,LLA是未定义的.

blocks.en:
For the cosine-silhouette, we set the contribution of a pixel to zero if its cluster contained only that pixel or if both its mean within-cluster distance and its smallest mean distance to another cluster were zero.
The metric was undefined when all valid pixels from the held-out specimens in a fold belonged to one cluster or when each of those pixels belonged to a different cluster.
blocks.zh:
对于cosine-silhouette,如果一个像素的组只包含该像素,或者它的组内平均距离和它到另一个组的最小平均距离均为零,我们就会将像素的贡献设定为零.
当一个折叠的悬浮标本中的所有有效像素都属于一个集群时,或者当每个这些像素属于一个不同的集群时,这个度量是没有定义的.

blocks.en: C.7 Cluster Label Alignment
blocks.zh: C.7 集群标签对齐

blocks.en:
To align display IDs and colors across conditions, we used the input spectra of pixels that were valid in all conditions.
For each condition, we calculated the mean 256-dimensional spectrum for each specimen–cluster combination, then averaged these spectra with equal weights across specimens containing pixels assigned to that cluster.
We excluded empty combinations from the average without substituting zeros.
The resulting spectrum retains zero mean across wavelengths, but its norm can vary.
blocks.zh:
为了在各种条件下对齐显示的ID和颜色,我们使用了在所有条件下都有效的像素的输入光谱.
对于每个条件,我们计算出每个标本的256维频谱的平均值 - 组群组合,然后在包含分配给该组群的像素的标本之间,以相等的权重平均这些光谱.
我们从平均值中排除了空组合,而不取代零。
由此产生的频谱在波长上保留了零平均值,但其规范可能有所不同.

blocks.en:
Using M00 as the reference, we applied the Hungarian algorithm to find the one-to-one correspondence that maximized the sum of cosine similarities between matched cluster mean spectra.
Each condition used the same correspondence to M00 for all specimens.
We recorded the similarities of matched spectra and the overlap of their labels on the same valid pixels. Only spectral similarity entered the matching objective.
Matching aligns display IDs and colors. A shared color does not imply chemical identity.
We calculated all metrics from the original partitions independently of the display alignment.
blocks.zh:
使用M00作为参考,我们应用了匈牙利算法来寻找一对一的对应数据,将匹配的集群平均光谱之间的余弦相似性的总和最大化.
每个条件对所有标本都使用了相同的M00对应.
我们记录了匹配光谱的相似性以及它们在同一有效像素上的标签的重叠. 只有光谱相似性进入匹配目标.
匹配坐标显示 ID 和 颜色 。 共同的颜色并不意味着化学特性。
我们从原有的分区中计算出所有的度量,独立于显示对齐.

blocks.en: Appendix D LLA and Spatial Association Measures
blocks.zh: 附录D 法学硕士和空间协会措施

blocks.en:
LLA, defined in Eq. ( 11 ), equals one minus the variance-weighted mean of Geary’s C C for the binary indicator variables of the individual clusters.
To show this, we first express LLA as a join-count agreement rate corrected for chance under random assignment of labels with the number of pixels in each cluster held fixed.
We then express the correction in terms of a ratio of disagreement rates and relate these rates to squared differences between neighboring indicators and to the variances of the indicators.
blocks.zh:
Eq. (11) 定义的 LLA 等于 Geary 的 C 的二进制指标变量的差值加权平均值的一减。
为了显示这一点,我们首先将LLA表示为合并计算协议费率,在随机分配标签的情况下,根据每个集群中固定的像素数量,修正机会。
然后,我们用差异率的比例来表示纠正,并将这些比率与相邻指标之间的平方差和指标的差异联系起来。

Appendix E Supplementary Comparisons and Sensitivity Analysis To supplement the evaluation of M11 and its components in Sections 6.1 – 6.3 , we examined variation in condition effects across repetitions, spatial maps from full-dataset fitting, and sensitivity to the mask ratio.
Appendix F examines the reproducibility of the partitions and their internal boundary configurations. E.1 Variability in Condition Effects across Repetitions We examined whether the effects of the reconstruction task and additional perturbations had the same direction when we repeated the entire procedure from representation learning through clustering.
Table D.2 gives the mean paired differences in LLA-5 and LFR(TGN+FS) for each repetition in two comparisons of reconstruction tasks and four comparisons of additional perturbations.
In each repetition, we calculated the difference between conditions within each specimen and averaged the differences with equal weight across the 49 specimens.
The improvement counts in Table 3 are based on each specimen’s mean over three repetitions, whereas the differences reported here are means across specimens for each repetition. Changing the reconstruction task to prediction of masked bands (M00 − - A0 and M11 − - A1) increased mean LLA-5 and decreased LFR(TGN+FS) in all three repetitions.
In all four comparisons of additional perturbations, LFR(TGN+FS) decreased in every repetition, but the direction of the change in LLA-5 varied across repetitions.

E.3.2 Full-Dataset Fitting Table D.2 compares M11(-50) and M11-75 after full-dataset fitting.
We trained M11-75 once on the same 401,408 401{,}408 pixels with the same training settings and prespecified training seed as in Section 5.3 .
For M11(-50), we reused the learned representations and evaluation results.
With each representation held fixed, we fitted Cosine-KMeans at K = 8 K=8 using the same three seeds.
For this supplementary analysis, we calculated the six metrics in Table D.2 on the full set of valid pixels and used the aggregation and display ID alignment conventions of Section 5.3 .
For cosine-silhouette, we calculated distances across all 49 specimens and averaged the pixelwise scores within each specimen.
Figure D.2 shows the first clustering result for the seven specimens used in the main comparison. M11-75 had higher mean LLA at all three neighborhood widths and higher mean maximum occupancy than M11(-50), with a similar mean number of clusters used.
The paired difference in LLA-5 averaged 0.0227 and was positive for 33 of 49 specimens.
For KYOw02790, M11-75 showed fewer of the banded regions seen with M11(-50), assigning larger areas to the same cluster.
In this specimen, higher LLA coincided with the merging of regions. Excessive merging could reduce sensitivity to differences in material state.
For this specimen, mean LLA-5 over three repetitions rose from 0.505 to 0.687 under full-dataset fitting but fell from 0.491 to 0.474 in OOF evaluation.
Thus, changing the mask ratio had different effects when the specimen was included in fitting and when it was evaluated as an unseen specimen. Table E.4: Mask ratio comparison after full-dataset fitting ( K = 8 K=8 , 49 specimens).

对于宇宙光线,我们计算出所有49个标本的距离,并平均得出每个标本中的像素分数。
图D.2显示主比较中使用的7个标本的第一个组群结果.

blocks.en:
M11-75 had higher mean LLA at all three neighborhood widths and higher mean maximum occupancy than M11(-50), with a similar mean number of clusters used.
The paired difference in LLA-5 averaged 0.0227 and was positive for 33 of 49 specimens.
For KYOw02790, M11-75 showed fewer of the banded regions seen with M11(-50), assigning larger areas to the same cluster.
In this specimen, higher LLA coincided with the merging of regions. Excessive merging could reduce sensitivity to differences in material state.
For this specimen, mean LLA-5 over three repetitions rose from 0.505 to 0.687 under full-dataset fitting but fell from 0.491 to 0.474 in OOF evaluation.
Thus, changing the mask ratio had different effects when the specimen was included in fitting and when it was evaluated as an unseen specimen.
blocks.zh:
M11-75在所有三个街区宽度上的平均LLAA都比M11(-50)高,平均占用上限也比M11(-50)高,使用的集群平均数量相似.
LLA-5的配对差异平均为0.0227,49个标本中有33个为阳性.
对于KYOw02790,M11-75显示的带状区域较少,只看到M11(-50),将更大的区域划入同一个集群。
在这个标本中,较高法学硕士学位与地区合并同时进行. 过度合并可能会降低对物质状态差异的敏感性。
对于这个标本,平均LLA-5三次重复从0.505升至0.687,但在OOF评价中从0.491降至0.474。
因此,当标本被列入标本时,当标本被评价为隐形标本时,改变遮罩比会产生不同的效果.

blocks.en: Table F.1: OOF partition agreement for the main comparison, ablations of the additional perturbations, and the supplementary mask ratio comparison.
blocks.zh: 表F.1: 妇女 OOF 主比较的分区协议,附加扰动的冲动,以及补充遮罩比比较.

blocks.en:
We interpret regions with particular NIR spectral features in light of their spatial distributions.
To assess whether mapped regions and their internal boundaries recurred across repetitions, we compared how pixels were grouped and where boundaries fell in each specimen.
Across conditions, we related partition agreement to LLA. For M11, we also compared the first map used for interpretation with those from the other repetitions.
blocks.zh:
我们根据其空间分布来解释具有国家清单报告谱系特征的区域。
为了评估所绘制的区域及其内部边界是否反复出现,我们比较了像素的分类方式以及每个样本的边界落到哪里。
在各种条件下,我们把分治协议与LLA联系起来。 就M11而言,我们还比较了第一张用于解释的地图和其他重复地图。

blocks.en: F.1 Partition Reproducibility across Conditions
blocks.zh: F.1 各条件的可分性

blocks.en:
We measured partition agreement with the adjusted Rand index (ARI) [ 25 ] . ARI is invariant to permutations of cluster labels. One indicates perfect agreement, zero is the chance baseline, and negative values are possible.
With the fitting pixels fixed, we compared assignments of all unperturbed valid pixels and averaged ARI over the three repetition pairs per specimen.
Because the pairs were dependent, we did not compute a between-repetition standard deviation.
ARI was undefined for fewer than two valid pixels and set to one if both partitions had a single cluster or both assigned each pixel to its own cluster.
We did not impute missing values. At K = 8 K=8 , every pair had a defined ARI in all 49 specimens.
Tables F.1 and F.2 report the equally weighted mean of the specimen averages.
Gray values after ± \pm give the between-specimen sample standard deviation. Boldface marks the highest mean in each table.
The interpretation of stability depends on which steps are repeated [ 47 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们用调整后的兰德指数衡量分区协议[25]. ARI对集群标签的排列不常见. 一个表示完全一致,零是机会基线,负值是可能的.
随着装配像素的固定,我们比较了所有未扰动的有效像素的任务,并平均比对每个标本的三对重复对的ARI.
因为对子是依赖性的,所以我们没有计算重复之间标准偏差.
对不到两个有效像素的ARI没有定义,如果两个分区都有一个单一的集群或两个都指定每个像素到自己的集群,则设置为一个.
我们没有将缺失的价值观归罪于人。 在K = 8 K = 8 时,每对在全部49个标本中都有定义的ARI.
表F.1和F.2报告标本平均值的加权平均值相同。
±\\pm后灰色值给出了 specimen 样本标准偏差. 粗体显示每个表格中最高的平均值。
对稳定的解释取决于重复哪些步骤[47]。

blocks.zh: 表F.2:全数据集装配后固定的Cosine-KMeans初始化协议。

blocks.en:
The three repetitions used the same folds and sampled pixels (Section 5.2.1 ).
For neural networks, we repeated representation learning and clustering.
Only clustering varied for B0 (fixed input spectra) and B1 (fixed fold-specific PCA transformations).
In OOF evaluation, all pixels of each held-out specimen were excluded from fitting.
blocks.zh:
三次重复使用相同的折叠和抽样像素(第5.2.1节).
对于神经网络,我们重复了表现学习和集群.
仅针对B0(固定输入光谱)和B1(固定折叠特定PCA变换)进行分组.
在OOF评价中,每个被搁置标本的所有像素都被排除在装配之外.

blocks.en:
Mean ARI for M11 exceeded those for A0, A1, and M00 but fell below those for B0, B1, M10, and M01 (Table F.1 ).
M11(-50), the main comparison condition with 50% masking, had the highest mean ARI across mask ratios. M11-75 had lower ARI despite higher LLA (Appendix E.3 ).
blocks.zh:
M11的平均反照率超过了A0、A1和M00,但低于B0、B1、M10和M01(表F.1)。
M11(-50),与50%的口罩比较的主要条件,在口罩比率之间平均反照率最高。 M11-75尽管拥有较高的法学硕士学位(附录E.3),但具有较低的学术影响。

blocks.en:
Across the six main conditions (Section 5.3 ), we fixed the representations and repeated Cosine-KMeans with three initializations.
We compared assignments of all valid pixels in all 49 specimens, including pixels outside the fitting set.
Cross-validation used different specimens for fitting and repeated different steps, so ARI differences cannot isolate variability from representation learning.
A1 had the highest mean LLA-5 and LLA-9 but the lowest mean ARI. M11 had lower ARI than M00 (Tables 4 and F.2 ).
Thus, spatial coherence within a segmentation and partition agreement across repetitions are distinct.
Since ARI disregards spatial coordinates, we also compared internal boundary positions [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh:
在6个主要条件(第5.3节)中,我们用3个初始化方法固定了陈述和重复的科辛-科米恩语。
我们比较了所有49个标本中所有有效像素的指派,包括装配组外的像素.
交叉验证使用不同的标本来配制和重复不同的步骤,因此ARI差异无法将变异性与代表性学习隔离.
A1拥有最高的平均值LLA-5和LLA-9,但最低的平均值ARI. M11的反照率低于M00(表4和F.2)。
因此,在重复的分割和分割协议中,空间一致性是不同的。
由于ARI无视空间坐标,我们还比较了内部边界位置[3].

blocks.en: F.2 Spatial Map Reproducibility in M11
blocks.zh: F.2 M11空间地图可复制

blocks.en:
For M11 at K = 8 K=8 , we fixed the fitting set at 8,192 pixels from each of the 49 specimens (401,408 pixels in total).
We trained M11 three times for 800 epochs per run, varying the random draws for initialization, pixel order, masking, and additional perturbations.
We ran Cosine-KMeans on each final representation with the same three initialization seeds, yielding nine maps per specimen.
We compared assignments of all 3,902,250 valid pixels, including pixels not used for fitting, without postprocessing or image registration.
These repetitions used the same observations and fitting pixels, so they exclude variability from reacquiring images or resampling pixels.
blocks.zh:
对于K=8 K=8的M11,我们把配位集固定在49个标本中的每个标本的8,192像素(共计401,408像素).
我们训练了M11三次 每跑800个时段, 改变随机抽取 初始化,像素顺序,面具,和额外的扰动。
我们用同样的三个初始化种子 对每一个最终代表物进行了Cosine-KMEANs的测试,每个标本生成9张地图。
我们比较了所有3,902,250个有效像素,包括不用于装配的像素,没有后处理或图像注册。
这些重复使用了相同的观测和配位像素,因此它们排除了变异性重新获取图像或重新复制像素.

blocks.en:
We indexed each map by its representation learning and clustering repetitions ( e , k ) (e,k) .
Of the 36 map pairs, nine shared a representation and 27 used different representations.
We also examined the subset of eight pairs comparing the first map ( 1 , 1 ) (1,1) , used for interpretation, with each of the other maps.
Comparisons across representations include variation from both learning and clustering.

在36对地图中,9对共用一个代表,27对使用了不同的代表。
我们还审查了用于解释的第一张地图(1,1,1)与其他各张地图相比较的8对地图的子集。
各种表述的比较包括学习和分组之间的差异。
